title: Yiza, Yiza Manuweli
lyrics: Yiza, yiza, Manuweli, Khulula u-Sirayeli, Uyalila kulentlango, Elind' u-Nyana ka-Thixo. Vuya! vuya! Sirayeli, Uza kuw'u-Manuweli.
Yiza, Ntonga yakwa-Isayi, Ubakhulule abakho Ku-Satana nesihogo, Ze baloyise nengcwaba. Vuya! vuya! Sirayeli, Uza kuw' u-Manuweli.
Yiza, Wena Khwezi lomso, Sivuse ngokuza kwakho, Gxoth'amafu obumnyama Kwa namathunzi okufa. Vuya! vuya! Sirayeli, Uza kuw'u-Manuweli.
Yiza, Nyana ka-Davide, Vul' amasango e-Zulu, Sikhokhelele phezulu, Usinqande ebubini. Vuya! vuya! Sirayeli, Uza kuw' u-Manuweli.
Yiza ke, Thixo Somandla, Owathi, kubantu bakho Phezu kwentaba ye-Sinayi, Wabanik' umthetho wakho. Vuya! vuya! Sirayeli, Uza kuw' u-Manuweli. - Amen

title: Yesu, Langa Lomphefumlo
lyrics: Yesu, Langa lompefumlo, Akumnyama xa ukhoyo: Makungabikho nany' into Enokundahlula nawe.
Ndakuhlelwa bubuthongo, Selecima nalamehlo, Mandibe ndicinga ngawe Nangophumlo olunawe.
Hlala nam imini yonke, Ungekho andingephile, Hlala nam kwakuza kuhlwa, Ize ndingoyik' ukufa.
U'ba kukh' umntwana wakho Othe wadel' izwi lakho, Z'umguqule umxolele, Az' onwabe xa elele.
Balunguze abafayo, Batyebis' abasweleyo, Nabo bonk' abalusizi Bakhangel' ubonwabise,
Yiza kuthi sakuvuka, Usigcine yonk' imihla, Side simke emhlabeni, Sibe nawe e-Zulwini. - Amen.

title: Zovakala Indudumo
lyrics: Zovakala indudumo Engcwabeni, Zondivusa ndisalele Engcwabeni, Kwakungena edlakeni Ukukhanya kwemibane, Londibiza ixilongo, Mandiphume.
M-Sindisi omanxeba Amahlanu Ndikhulule mina moni Ezonweni, 'Ze babone ndinophawu Lawo umnqamlez' ongcwele, 'Ze ndithembe xa ndiphuma Engcwabeni.
Ndihlangane ne-Ngelosi Emafini, Ndiyivume aph' ingoma Yoloyiso, Ze ndingene kumasango Ase-Bhotwe e-golide, Ndibulele ndidumise E-Zulwini. - Amen.

title: Bawo, Ndingumntwana Wakho
lyrics: Bawo, ndingumntwana Wakho, Noko ndonileyo, Ndiyalila phambi kwakho, Bawo, ndixolele.
Iziphoso zam zininzi, Azinakubalwa, Noko ndibhekisa kuwe, Bawo, ndixolele.
Imithetho ndiyaphule, Wena ndakudela, U-Msindisi ndimlahlile, Bawo, ndixolele.
Ndone ngako ukuthetha Ndone nangengcinga, Ndone nangemisebenzi, Bawo, ndixolele.
Noko ndibe ndifanele Ukukubulela, Ndisuke ndakulibala, Bawo, ndixolele.
Ngaz' izono ezininzi, Bawo, ndikonile, Wena ndikuhlazisile, Bawo, ndixolele.
Ungu-Thixo onenceba Engazang' iphele Ngoko ndiyalila, ndithi, Bawo, ndixolele. - Amen.

title: Kwaye Kukho Abalusi
lyrics: Kwaye kukho abalusi Belind' ebusuku I-Sithunywa seza kubo Baye besoyika.
Sasisithi i-Sithunywa, 'Ningoyiki nina, Ndinishumayez' indaba Ezivuyisayo.
'Ngokokuba nizalelwe Namhla u-Msindisi Ongu-Kristu eyi-Nkosi, Nangu umqondiso,
'Usana nolufumana Emzini ka-Davide Lusongelw' eziqhiyeni Emkhombeni we-stali.'
Kwabe kukho ngesiqupe Kunye ne-Ngelosi Umkhosi wase-Zulwini, Udumis' usithi:
'Udumiso malubekho Ku-Thix' e-Zulwini Inkolelo ebantwini Ngamaxesha onke.' - Amen.

title: Hay' Inyweba Yabo
lyrics: Hay' inyweba yabo Bantliziy' inyulu! Ngabo abombon' u-Thixo, Yen' ahlale kubo.
Owashiy' i-Zulu, Esiza nobomi Abe ngohlal' ebantwini, Eyi-Nkosi yabo,
Usazinikela Kozithobileyo Ath' omsulwa ngentliziyo Amenz' indlu yakhe.
Sakufuna, Nkosi, Siph' elithamsanqa Intliziyw' emsulwa kanye Eyingcwele yakho, - Amen.

title: Kuthethw' Izimanga Ngawe
lyrics: Kuthethw' izimanga Ngawe, Tsiyoni, Mzi ka-Thixo, Low' olizwi lingephulwe Uhlala kuwe Yena. Usekwe phezu kolwalwa, Akushukumi ngoko, Ungqongiwe lusindiso, Utshab' alunto Kuwe.
Amanzi ampompozayo Atsawul' eluthandweni, Onyana nentombi zakho Bayaneliswa ngawo. Ngubanin' onxaniweyo? Nang' empompoz' amanzi Angasokuze aphele, Alubabalo lwakhe.
Indlu zakho zonganyelwe Lil' ilifu nomlilo Ziyathetha ziyaxela Zith' i-Nkos' ikufuphi. Ibakhokele intsika, Ikukhany' ebusuku, Badl' i-man' imihla yonke Abamkeliswa yona.
Ndingumntwana womzi Wakho, I-Tsiyone, Msindisi, Ndoqhayisa nge-Gama Lakho, Malidel' izwe lona. Ubuyolo belilizwe Bobomzuzwana kodwa, Imivuyo yaphakade Yeyosapho lwe-Tsiyoni. - Amen.

title: Khangelani Nizibone
lyrics: Khangelani nizibone Izibele ezingaka, Zityhiliwe ngu-Msindisi Owafela thina 'bantu.
Besihamba emnyameni, Singenalo ukhanyiso, Besihamba ekoneni, Singakwazi ukulunga.
Wasinceda Wena, Thixo, Ngobubele obukhulu, Wasinik' u-Nyana Wakho Wasikhanyisela ngaye.
Simbulela ongu-Yesu, Thina boni abonayo, Wazizek' izono zethu, Wazithwala Yena Yedwa.
Wena, Moya Oyingcwele, Uz' ungene kuthi sonke Usincede, sikubone Oko kwenziwayo nguye. - Amen.

title: Lizalis' Idinga Lakho
lyrics: Lizalis' idinga lakho, Thixo, Nkosi yenyaniso, Zonk' intlanga zalomhlaba Mazizuze usindiso.
Amadolo kwelilizwe Makagobe phambi Kwakho, Zide zithi zonk' ilwimi, Ziluxel' udumo Lwakho,
Lawula! lawula! Yesu, Nkosi, Koza ngawe ukonwaba, Ngeziphithiphithi zethu Yonakele imihlaba.
Bona izwe lakowethu, Uxolel' izono zalo, Ungathob' ingqumbo Yakho, Luze lufusapho lwalo.
Yala singatshabalali, Usiphile ukhanyiso, Bawo, ungasibulali, Ngokudela inyaniso.
Nkosi, khawusikelele Imfundiso zezwe lethu, Uze usivuselele, Siphuthume ukulunga. - Amen.

title: Ma-Kristu, Khaliphani
lyrics: Ma-Kristu, khaliphani Ekulwen' elidabi, Eso-Sonka so-Bomi Masomeleze nina.
Olusizi alunto, Nenyembezi azinto, Nokoyika akunto, Ninikw' ukomelela.
Vuyani ngentliziyo, Hambani niphethele, Nilwe ngokukhalipha, Uloyiso lolwenu.
Ma-Kristu, niyafunzwa, Nok' intshaba zininzi Lolwenu uloyiso, Phambili ke, ma-Kristu!
Uzuko kuwe, Yise, Uzuko kuwe, Nyana, Nakuwe, Moy' Ongcwele, Ngawo onke amaxa. - Amen.

title: Luthando, Endenziwe Nguwe
lyrics: Luthando, endenziwe nguwe Ndifuze Wena ngaphakati, Ndandilahleke, wandifuna, Ndikude wandifuna Wena, Luthando, ndizinike kuwe Ndibe ngowako wedwa kanye.
Luthando, kade wandifuna, Ndingekabikho wandinyula, Wazalwa apha emhlabeni, Usinyusele e-Zulwini, Luthando ndizinike kuwe, Ndibe ngowakho wedwa kanye.
Luthando, wafa ngomnqamlezo Bunzima ubuhlungu Bakho, Wasizuzela ukuphila Novuy' olungenakuphela Luthando, ndizinike Kuwe, Ndibe ngowakho wedwa kanye.
Luthando, undithanda futhi, Uman' ukundithethelela Waqala wandihlawulela, Ngothand' olungenakubalwa, Luthando, ndizinike Kuwe, Ndibe ngowakho wedwa kanye.
Luthando, ngezwi elikhulu Undikhuphile ekufeni, Ngamandla akho amakhulu Ndohlala nawe e-Zulwini, Luthando, ndizinike kuwe, Ndibe ngowakho wedwa kanye. - Amen.

title: Msindisi Waboni
lyrics: Msindisi waboni, Ndisondele kuwe: Msindisi waboni, Ndizibika kuwe.
Akukho nalinye Endilithethayo, Akukho nandawo Ndizincoma ngayo.
Ndisindwa ngumthwalo Ondixhalisayo, Umnced' andinaye Ondikhululayo.
Asikuko nokuba Ndililo ijacu, Ndithwele ihlazo, Kuba ndingumoni.
Ndincolile kanye Emphefumlweni, Ndiyiyo imfama Eselusizini.
Nakuba ke, Nkosi, Ndiyinto engento, Ndiyazi ukuba Andiyikugxothwa.
Ndibamb' amadinga Owabekileyo, Ndigcine amazwi Owathethileyo.
Msindisi waboni, Ndisabela kuwe, Msindisi waboni, Ndiphephela kuwe. - Amen.

title: Njengebhadi Libhadula
lyrics: Njengebhadi libhadula Ngokufun' umthombo, Ikufuna njalo, Thixo, Eyam intliziyo.
Inxaniwe intliziyo, Inxanelw' u-Thixo, Ewe, lowo waziwayo Ungophilileyo.
* Bandibuza, ndasibeka Isililo mina, Bakuhlala bendibuza 'Uno-Thixo phina?'
* Zaphalala inyembezi Ndakuba ndindedwa, Ndakucinga ngabaninzi Abangasekhoyo.
* Kuba namhla ndinjenjenje, Ndililolo apha: Ndandisiya nezihlwele Kuyo indlu yakho.
* Ndotsho ndithi, 'O Thixo wam, Undilahlele ni, De ndihlekwe, luth' utshaba, 'Uno-Thixo phina?'
Kunganina, mphefumlo wam, Udakumbileyo? Bek' ithemba lakho kuye Uthuthuzeleke. - Amen.

title: Nkosi, Sihlangene
lyrics: Nkosi, sihlangene, Sisendlwini yakho, Yiza nawe, sesingene Ebusweni bakho.
Izithetho zakho, Bawo, masizive Kwase-Kerikeni yakho, Nawe masikuve.
Intliziyo yethu Iyakugulela, Nawo umphefumlo wethu Uyakukhangela.
Mawusilungise Thina bantu bakho, Sakubhubha singenise E-Zulwini lakho. - Amen.

title: Sinelizwi Lika-Thixo
lyrics: Sinelizwi lika-Thixo, Sinobomi ngalo, Siyazaz' izono zethu, No-msindisi, ngalo.
Lihambile elo-Lizwi, Lisahamba lona, Ezozizwe ezikude, Zilindele lona.
Ziyoyisw' intshaba zakho, Nge-Zwi lakho, Nkosi, Wozalisw' umhlaba wonke Li-Zwi lakho, Nkosi.
Imilambo yelilizwe Yovuyiswa lilo, Abantwana bezizwe Bolulekwa lilo.
Zopheliswa' imfazwe zonke, Nge-Zwi lakho, Thixo, Kwakulawul' uxolo lodwa Nge-Zwi lakho, Thixo. - Amen.

title: Singabakho! Bawo Wethu
lyrics: Singabakho! Bawo wethu, Mawusive e-Zulwini, Masihlale singabakho Wonk' unaphakade.
Singabakho! Bomi bethu, Nguwe osiphilisayo, Kusaliwa emhlabeni, Masigcinwe nguwe.
Singabakho! nguwe wedwa Oyi-Nene, oyi-Ndlela, Masihlale sifundiswa, Sikhokelwa nguwe.
Singabakho! sizigusha Ezihlala zilahleka, Masisinde, Sobubele, Ngokwaluswa nguwe.
Singabakho! Nkosi yethu Masiphiwe konke nguwe Sikhululwe ekoneni Sigoduswe nguwe. - Amen.

title: Thixo, Ngobubele Bakho
lyrics: Thixo, ngobubele bakho Usiphil' i-Lizwi lakho, Elo-Lizwi elikhulu, Elivela ngaphezulu.
Lona liyasifundisa, Lona liyasivuyisa, Liyasusa ubumnyama, Libonis' abazimfama.
Besihamba endleleni Ekhokelel' ekufeni, Eli-Lizwi leza kuthi, Ngoko sobulela futhi.
Ngeli-Lizwi sabuyiswa, Ngeli-Lizwi sasindiswa, Lasisonga ebubini, Size siye e-Zulwini.
Malihambe eli-Lizwi Mazilive zonk' izizwe Lide lifundise bonke Abasendaweni zonke. - Amen.

title: Hozana Enyangweni
lyrics: Hozana enyangweni Ndivuma ngezwi lam Kunyana kaDavide Ozayo ngenxa yam. Hozana! undisiza Ebunzimeni bam, Uyeza akabizwa OngumSindisi wam.
Ndovatha ezinjani, Wakutyelela kum? Yilungisele Wena Yonk' intliziyo yam, Ndiyinikele kuwe OnguMhlanguli wam, Ma iqubude kuwe Ngenene, Nkosi yam.
Ndandikhululwe nguwe Entolongweni yam. Se liqhawulwe nguwe, Ikhamandela lam. Elandincamisayo, Ndalahl' ubomi bam, Se undivuyisile Ekulileni kwam. - Amen.

title: Wabengezela Umbono
lyrics: Wabengezela umbono, Owamchwayitisayo Um-profite wakwa-Yuda, Ngokuva ezolwimi.
Yaye i-Nkosi irawulwe Zizandekela zayo, Zizalise i-Tempile, Zikhungel' engomeni:-
'Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Nkosi: Uzalise i-Zulu, Ngobuqaqawuli bakho, Yamkela ke uzuko.'
Zisalila e-Zulwini, Nomhlab' uyathelela Kulengoma ye-Ngelosi- 'Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Nkosi.'
Uyazukiswa phezulu Zizandekela zakhe, Ngengoma enye neyethu, Thina Kerike yakhe:
'Nkosi, obakh' ubungcwele Buzalise i-Zulu, Wena Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Yamkela indumiso.' - Amen.

title: Wena Moy' Ongcwele
lyrics: Wena Moy' Ongcwele, Yihla phezu kwethu, Njengomhla we-Pentekoste, Ngalemini yakho.
Sihlangene apha Kuyo lendlu yakho, Njengomhla wakw' amaza, Silind' idinga le-Nkosi- U-Moya wofefe.
Njengomoy' uqutha Phezu kwaw' amaza, Zuziphefumlele njalo Intliziyo zethu.
Sibabale sonke Ngo-Moya wengqondo, Siphe ilwimi zomlilo Sidumise ngazo.
Moy' Ongcwele, yiza, Gxotha ubumnyama, Yenza sivuthe uthando, Lona lwemfezeko.
Moya wenyaniso, Hlal' uhleli nathi, Moya wobunyana bethu, Mawusingcwalise. - Amen.

title: Xa Umhlab' Uphithizela
lyrics: Xa umhlab' uphithizela Ngemihlali eshukuma, X' amazulu edunuma, Kuwe wedwa ndokhangela.
Xa umhlab' ubengezela, Uthi, mandiwulandele, Ngamadolo ndizigoba, Kuwe wedwa ndokhangela.
Xa ubutsha bundihenda, Nemihlali indikhoba, Ngamadolo ndizigoba, Kuwe wedwa ndokhangela.
Xa kuvuka uqhwithela Oluduba i-Karke, Yesu, zundikhedamele, Kuwe wedwa ndokhangela.
Onk' amazwi abukhali Makahlabe, makasike, Noko mina mandizame Kuwe wedw' ukukhangela.
Kuwe wedwa, Yesu, Ndlela, Mandibek' i-Yoredane, 'De ndiweli' i-liso lami, Kuwe wedwa ndikhangela. - Amen.

title: Yanga Intliziyo Yam
lyrics: Yanga intliziyo yam Ingaphuma ezonweni, Wanga umphefumlo wam Ungangen' ebungcweleni, Yiva, yiva, Nkosi yam, Yiva, ukukhunga kwam.
Kwanga ukuhamba kwam Kungabeka e-Zulwini, Zanga zonk' izenzo zam Zingayama e-Nkosini, Nceda, nceda, Nkosi yam, Nceda ukukhunga kwam.
Kwanga ukuvuya kwam Ndingavuya futhi ngawe, Ndanga ndinga, Nkosi yam, Ndibe se-Zulwini nawe Vuma, vuma, Nkosi yam, Ndiye e-Zulwini nam. - Amen.

title: Yesu, Wena Ungu-Mhlobo
lyrics: Yesu, Wena ungu-Mhlobo, U-mhlobo womphefumlo, Ndiza kuwe undincede, Uncede lentliziyo.
Themba limbi andinalo Endingabamba lona, Nqaba yimbi andinayo Endingangena kuyo.
Ndizibika kuwe, Nkosi, Ndiyint' engenamhlobo Ndithemb' umsebenzi wakho Lowo wothando lwakho.
Ndiza kuzifaka kuwe Phantsi kwephiko lakho' Ndakuba ndingene khona Ndingaswela nto-nina?
Nguwe wedwa ongu-Mthombo, U-Mthombo wab' ubomi, Apho bangahlamba khona Bonke abangaboni.
Hlamba lentliziyo yami, Uyenze msulwa yona, Yicokise, yilungise, Uyenze ngcwele yona. - Amen.

title: Jerusalem engcwele
lyrics: JERUSALEM engcwele, Eyase-Zulwini, Umlomo uye yiswa Yinkazimlo yakho,
Buphezu kwembaliso Ubungcwele bakho, Luphezu kokuqonda Noloyolo lwakho.
Im'i-Jerusaleme Ngenkazimlo yayo, Izele zi-Ngelosi Na-Bangcwele bayo, I-Nkos'ihleli khona Ngenkaziml'enkulu, Buphezu kwembaliso Ubukhulu bayo.
Bulaph'ubukumkani Obuka-Davide, Balapho ababonga I-Gama lo-Yesu, Kulapho ukuphumla Kwabadiniw eyo, Likhaya labo bonke Abasindileyo.
Sikungxamele sonke, Khaya la-Bangcwele, Sincede, Nkosi Yesu, Size silamkele, Siphulaphule, Thixo, Baw'onobubele, Zungasishiyi nawe, Moya Oyingcwele. - Amen.

title: Iziqhamo zotywala
lyrics: IZIQHAMO zotywala Zizililo nenduma, Buthandisa ukulwa, Ingxolo nenkunkuma.
Bunen kohlis' utywala, Buthembis' ukonwaba, Kanti ke bakuselwa Buluma nje ngeramba.
Bucuth' ubomi be thu Budala ingevane, Bunamehlo abomvu, Bunesizunguzane.
Bunencas' enokufa, Nobuhlungu benyoka, Bubulala nemveku, Butyhutyha nje ngempehla.
Abakhohliswa bubo Beyela bengaqondi, Bangena kulo mbubo Besith' akukho ntlondi.
Abangenayo kubo Abasenakuphuma, Bakh' abafela kubo Bengasenasidima.
Lumka ke ungeyeli, Akuyi lubuyayo , Yamkela umKhululi I-Nkos' ekuthandayo.
NguYe yedw' umPhilisi Wazo zonke izifo , NguYesu umSindisi Wabo bonk' abonayo. - Amen.

title: Thixo, owobawo bethu
lyrics: THIXO, owobawo bethu, Owabakhokela bona, Nathi siyinzala yabo, Ma usikhokele thina.
Wabalondoloza bona, Enkcithakalweni yabo , Wabakhusela kwa bona, Kuzo zonk' iingozi zabo.
Onke amadinga ethu, Okugcina izwi laKho, Waqinise ngexa lethu Ngabo ubuThixo baKho.
Nathi, Bawo, sizibeka Kweso sandla sobubele, Ma sithi sakuzibika Yonk' inceba usenzele. - Amen.

title: Omny' umnyaka uthwasile
lyrics: OMNY'umnyaka uthwasile, Nang'ufike siphilile, Thixo wethu, sibulela, Ngaye lowo wasifela.
Thukulul' ilwimi zethu Nceda ukucula kwethu, Sikubonge, sibulele, Olo gcino silwamkele.
Yonk' imihl' eyongezwayo Yobu bomi bolulwayo, Ma sikunikele kuWe Konke okubizwa nguWe.
Ma sidlule kokukhoyo, Siphuthume okuzayo, Ma sihambe, zonk' imini, Sikhumbule ezulwini. - Amen.

title: Vumani kuYehova
lyrics: VUMANI kuYehova Ntbong'igama laKhe, Ntlondolozwe nguYe, Ma nenz' udumo lwaKhe.
Kufik'umnyaka omtsha, Omdala se umkile, Sisekho ebomini, Uninzi se lufile.
Ma singazilibali Ezo nto sizamkele, Ngomnyak'ogqithileyo, NgobaKhe ububele.
Nezono sona ngazo, Phakathi kwexa lawo, Sicela uxolelo, Zimkiswe kwa nje ngawo.
Ngalo uvelileyo, Kwa yonk' imihla yawo, Ma senz'inkonzo yethu Ilunge kuwe, Bawo.
Ma singakuqumbisi Ngokwenza sikwenzayo, Ma singakudanisi Ngezimvo sizivayo.
Sithemb'uthando lwaKho Wasiph' uYesu ngalo, Sincede ngenxa yaKhe Ikesha sisenalo.
Sandule, lakuphela, Sicande emafini, Sinyuke nomSindisi, Sihlale ezulwini. - Amen.

title: HLALA nami
lyrics: HLALA nami litshonil' ilanga Ubusuku bufikile, Nkosi, Ma ndingasali ndingenamncedi, Ndenzel' uncedo ngokuhlala nam.
Buya khaw'le za obu bomi bam Ndiya shiywa zezomhlab' izin to Ndibona iinguquleko zodwa, Wen' ongaguqukiyo: Hlala nam.
Yiba soloko ukufuphi nam, Undigxothele zonk' intshaba zam Nguwe Nkosi onokundigcina, Phakathi kwentsunguzi: Hlala nam.
Andinakuxhala kukho Wena, Intlungu neentsizi azinani, Luphi uloyiso lwakho ngcwaba ? Ndiya koyisa xa Uhleli nam.
Zibonakalis' emehlweni am Uz'undikhombise okwezulu Ndikhanvisele yonk' indlela yam, Nasekufeni kwam Uz'ube nam. - Amen.

title: Kuhlwile, imini yaphela
lyrics: KUHLWILE, imini yaphela, Lise litshonile ilanga, Inkan'yo ezintle zezulu zavela, Yaphuma ngobuhle inyanga.
Kubantu nasezinkomeni Uphumlo lomzimba luphiwe, Kuphumla nomoya usebuthongweni, Ulel'ungasaxhalisiwe.
Uhleli olondolozayo, Akaze afin' ukozela, Usonga ngesandla esingadinwayo, Intshab' ezifun' ukuvela.
Solala sisekuthembeni Sisezingalweni zoMgcini, Naxa singabizwa sisebuthongweni, Singaya kuvuk' ezulwini. - Amen.

title: Sisekho emhlabeni
lyrics: SISEKHO emhlabeni Sisadl' ubomi bethu, Sigcinwe elishweni, NgumLondolozi wethu. Ma simbulele sonke, Kwa ngenyameko yonke, Silulamele sonke Ngase Nkosini yethu.
Sivuke siphilile, Kwa ngobubele baYo, Kaloku se kuhlwile, Sisenentlalo ngaYo. Samkel' ukutya kwethu Kwa nezivatho zethu, Sanikw' indlela yethu Ngalo ufe fe lwaYo.
Solala ngokonwaba, Ngobu busuku bonke, Asikoyika ntshaba, In Kos' iphezu konke. Yobona xa silele, Yoman' isikhangele, Yowenza ngobubele, Kwa ngamaxesha onke. - Amen.

title: IMIN' iya phela
lyrics: IMIN' iya phela Se kumathunzi, Ku fike ixesha Lokusiphumza.
Yesu, mthuthuzele Odiniweyo, Uz'uthamsanqele Oxakiweyo.
Xolis' abantwana Xa balalayo, Ukhusele bonke Abahambayo.
Osezintlungwini Uz'umphulule Abasebubini Zabahlargule.
Ndakuba ndilele Ndingasazi nto, Yalez'üngelosi Zindingabise.
Kothi xa kusile Ndakuvuka nam, Ma ndibe ngomsulwa Ngentliziyo yam.
Udumo kuYise Nakuy'uNyana, Nakuye uMoya, Ngonaphakade. - Amen.

title: NKOSI sisondela
lyrics: NKOSI sisondela Kwisihlalo saKho, Abazali nabazalwa, Sikho phambi kwaKho.
Buka, Nkosi! yona Le ntlangano yethu, Abazali nabantwana, Yonke indlu yethu.
Sibulela, Thixo! Zonk'izipho zaKho, Sinokudla, sineengubo, Sinelizwi laKho.
Sing'ungasamkela Kuyo indlu yaKho, Sifundise, sisindise, Siph'uxolo lwaKho.
Mawusihlalise Sithandane kunye, Sabelane, sincedane, Nje ngabendlu enye.
Mawusihambise Siphuthume kunye, Elo khaya lilizulu, Singafuni limbi.
Mawusingenise Kwelo khaya laKho, Abazali nabantwana, Ebusweni baKho. - Amen.

title: VUKA, mphefumlo wami
lyrics: VUKA, mphefumlo wami Nants' imini ivelile, Ihlaziy' impilo yami Ithi kum "Uphilile".
Ma simbonge u Yehova Ngale mpil' asiphile yo, Abaninzi baya gula, Kukho nababubileyo.
Ma luvuke lonk' uluntu Lumdumise u Yehova, Ngenxa yolu gcino lw a Khe Enzulwini yobusuku.
Ngale mini esinayo Ma sikhonz' u Thixo ngayo, Ithi yonk' inkqubo yethu Singcwalise Yena kuyo. - Amen.

title: SIPHAHLIWE zizibele
lyrics: SIPHAHLIWE zizibele, Ze zomzimba nezomxhelo, Noko singazifanele, Zikho, zingenasiphelo.
Ebusuku nasemini, USomandla uya gcina, Esahleli ezulwini, Nanku esibona thina.
Oku kuhlwa, Bawo wethu, Sikubong'ukondla kwa Kho, Sibulel'ukutya kwethu, Nako konke esinako.
Ngoku sizibeka ku We, Usilinde sakulala, Maxa sikhuselwa ngu We, Asinak'ukwenzakala.
Iinto esikone ngazo Sixolele zona zonke, Izoyiko neenkathazo Uzisonge kuthi sonke.
Ma siphumle sonwabile, Nga Ye umSindisi wethu, Xa anathi sinqabile, Yena uliliwa lethu - Amen.

title: YESU! Mhlobo wabantwana
lyrics: YESU! Mhlobo wabantwana Ndiza kuWe themba lam, Nas'isandla ndikhokele Ndise ekhayeni lam. Hleze ndilahleke mpela, Ndiyiphos'indlela yam Andibaqe uSatana, Andenze ixhoba nam.
Ndikhuthazwa kukubona Kuyo yonk'indiela yam. Amanyathel'aKho khona, Kumke ukoyika kwam. Kanti naWe Wazithoba, Wayinyama kwa nje ngam, Wazithwala zonk'iintsizi Ungemon'ofana nam.
Yesu! Lulam' elikhulu Yenza le ntliziyo yam, Ilifanele izulu, Ngokuhlamb'izono zam. Ndinga ndingafuza Wena Kubo ubulumko bam, Ndize ndiwazuz'amandla Okukhonzi'Nkosi yam. - Amen.

title: OWAQAL' esemncinane
lyrics: OWAQAL' esemncinane Ukumkhonz' uThixo wakhe Uya vuya yena. Usindile, enje njalo, Kwiinkathazo ezininzi, Emhlabeni apha.
Icham lakhe lelikhulu, Iinoyolo, linamandla, Ngamaxesha onke , Xa u Yesu amlandela, Ngokuthanda, nangokwenza Konke okungcwele.
Le nto iyinene kanye, Bonke abamkhonz' uThixo Banenyhweba bona. Ngu Ye lowo ongu Mncedi, Wokunceda ngeento zonke Zomabin' amazwe.
Ma ndithembe Yena ngoko Ndikhangele ku Ye yedwa Ukonwaba kwami. Ndiyilahl' inkonzo yimbi, Ma ndiyenze intw' enkulu Yonk' inkonzo ya Khe. - Amen.

title: UYEZA! uyeza! umGwebi omkhulu
lyrics: UYEZA! uyeza! umGwebi omkhulu Abantu bobona iNkosi yezulu, Babeya kuvuswa kwa semanchwabeni Babonakaliswe kwa sekukhanyeni.
Izinto esizibonayo zotshiswa, Amawa neentaba zonyiblikiswa, Ilanga locinywa, inyanga yophela, Aboni abakuba nakuzimela.
UmGwebi wofika nomkhosi omkhulu Umkhosi wezaKh' izithunywa zezulu, Amehlo omGwebi omkhulu obona Izinto zasese, izinto zokona.
Aboni boba nelikhulu ivuso, Bongcangcazelela obaKhe ubuso, Abangalungile botshatyalaliswa, Kwa sesihogweni somlilo botshiswa.
Yekani izono, noyike, nilunge, Iiveni ilizwile Nkosi, nikhunge, Zithandazeleni, nifun' izibele, Lixesha kaloku, yizan' anamkele. - Amen.

title: SINGABAZALWANA, singabazalwana
lyrics: SINGABAZALWANA, singabazalwana, Lusapho lweNkosi enkulu, Singe sithandana, singe sithandana, Awukho umona phezulu.
Singabancedani, singabancedani, Bakhonzi beNkosi enkulu, Nge singahlukani, nge singahlukani, Akwenziwa njalo phezulu.
Sisemkhosini mnye, sisemkhosini mnye, Makroti eNkosi enkulu, Singe siyilwela kwa ngantliziyo-nye, Akukho bugwala phezulu.
Ezulwini liny e mvuyelelweni Sobong' uKumkani omkhulu, Kungawo amandla avel' eNkosini Esoda sifike phezulu. - Amen.

title: SIKUYO indlela yelizwe lobomi
lyrics: SIKUYO indlela yelizwe lobomi, Ikhaya labantu bahleli ngenyhweba. Nna ke nahluka kuThixo ngokona, Nthi ni?noya na ?noya na phezulu?
Noya na, noya na, noya na, noya na? Nithi ni? noya na? noya na phezu lu?
Usizi, usizi, alunakuba kho, Kwelo zwe, bangcwele abalihambayo. Bahambi kanzima, nigaitywa bububi, Nithi ni? noya na? noya na phezu lu?
Kwelo zwe akukho buhlwempu nakanye, Zindyebo ngeendyebo izinto zikhoyo. Isifo asikho. Hay' asingebikho. Nithi ni? noya na? noya na phezu lu?
Hambani bakhonzi, elo zwe lelethu, Songqina singqine inyameko zalo. Ewe ke, sohamba ngaphezu kwentaba, Sisele amanzi ovuyo phezu lu.
Nakana ke, moni, asikulahlile, Simil'umzuzwana, simele kwa wena. Yiza ke kuThixo, az' akusingathe Akuse kwa ngoku, ekusa phezu lu.
Ndicinga ngokuthi, usebunzimen, Usithi, Ngubani ongalisusayo Ityala lingaka liseniliziyweni? Ngu Yesu kuphela, thandaza ke, uye.
Ndobamba, ndobamba, ndobamba, ndobamba. Ewe ke, ndobamba ndisiya phezu lu. - Amen.

title: BONGANI, bongani iNkosi yezulu
lyrics: BONGANI, bongani iNkosi yezulu, Kunamhla sibon' ukukhanya kweCawa. Yimini kaThixo, yimini enkulu, Yimini yemini, licham ebantwini.
UThixo wadala izulu nomhlaba, Wabuya waphumla ngemini yeCawa. Ithamsanqa laKhe labekwa ke kuyo, Kungoko loo mini kusithwa ingcwele.
UKristu kanjalo, ngeyaKhe imini, Wavuk' ekufeni, wabonwa ehleli. Kungoko kumiswe le mini yeNkosi, Ndaweni yaleya yamiswa kuqala.
Ngemini engcwele kwindawo ngendawo Abantu beNkosi bahlanganisene, NgoMoya kaThixo, uMoya kaBawo, Besenza inkonzo, bevuya kunene. - Amen.

title: JERUSALEM, ikhaya lam
lyrics: JERUSALEM, ikhaya lam, Endilithandayo, Wofezwa nin' umzamo wam? Ze ndiphumle kuwe.
Obona nin'amehlo am Loo masango mahle, Nezitrato zegolide, Zomzi wosindiso ?
Umzi omhle kune Eden, Ongangenwa sono, Nezihlalo zawo zihle, Ndikhumbula wona.
Zingandidakumbisa na Lintungu nokufa ? Se ndiyibon' iKanana Engunaphakade.
Namabandl' abapostile Angqong' uMsindisi, Nabo bonk' abaku Kristu Baya kuya khona.
Ndiya kulangazelela, Jenusalem entsha, Imizamo yam yophela Ndakufika kuwe. - Amen.

title: HAY' inyhweba abanayo
lyrics: HAY' inyhweba abanayo Abangcwele baphezulu Abemiyo phambi kwayo Iterone yekomkhulu.
Sihle isihlwele sabo, lingelosi zibangqonga! Intle nalo ntsholo yabo Bayenzayo bakubonga!
Nabo khon' esazulwini Abangubo zablanjwayo, Zenzwa mhlophe egazini Lal' oMvana yalophayo.
Bathi ukubonga kwabo Bayibong' iMvana leyo, Bambulel' uThixo wabo Konke abakwenzelweyo.
Kupheliswe lonk' ityala, Kugqityelwe ubunqambi, Akasekho namaxhala, Abanxanwa, abalambi.
Ukuphumla bakuphiwe, Baya hlala bonwabile, Iinyembezi zisuliwe, Zonk' intlungu ziphelile.
Ndinga nam ndingema nabo, Abo bantu abangcwele, Ndidumis' iNkosi yabo, Leyo Mvana ibafele. - Amen.

title: ZULU, khaya lami!
lyrics: ZULU, khaya lami! Uthandiwe ndimi. Zulu, khaya lami! Ulindiwe ndimi. Zulu, khaya lami! Unqwenelwa ndimi, Uno-Bawo wami, Une-Nkosi yami.
Zulu, khaya lami! Uthenjiwe ndimi. Zulu, khaya lami! Unobomi bami, Ndakubeka panti Obu budlulayo, Ndofumana kuwe Obungapheliyo.
Unelifa lami Elingabhubhiyo Elingagugiyo, Elingangcoliyo. Zulu, khaya lami! Uvuyelwa ndimi, Unobuhle bami, Nobungcwele bami.
Kweli ihlabati Ndingowa ewile, Ndingohlala apha Ezingcolisile. Ebuhleni kuwe Ndohlambululeka, Enkohlakalweni Ndakukhululeka. - Amen.

title: BULELANI ku Yehova
lyrics: BULELANI ku Yehova, Kuba elungile, Kuba ububele baKhe Bubobaphakade.
Matsho amaSirayeli, Indlu zawo zonke, Athi, ububele baKhe Bubobaphakade.
Ndamemeza ku Yehova, Ndandisengxingweni, Wandinceda wandibeka Endawen' ebanzi.
Ingecala lam iNkosi, Andisokoyika, Ingasuka ithi ni na Le nto umntu kumi ?
Ingecala lam inKosi, Iya kundinceda, Indincede ngokummandi Kwabandithiyayo.
Uku themba u Yehova, Nokuphepha nga Ye, Kuko okulungileyo, Kungathenjwa bantu.
Ma ndisinde nga We nKosi Undisikelele! Ma ndiphumle nga We nKosi Undithamsanqele. - Amen.

title: MASIBULELE ku Yesu
lyrics: MASIBULELE ku Yesu, Ngokuba wasifela. Wasenzela izibele Ngokusifela kwa Khe.
Taru ! Bawo, Yiba nofefe kuthi.
Thina bantwana bemfama, Oweza kuthi apha. Akwakhetha bala lamntu, Wafel' abazimfama. Taru ! Bawo, Yiba nofefe kuthi.
Abantsundu, nabamhlophe, Ma babulele kunye, Ma bavakalise bonke, Baculele iNkosi. Taru ! Bawo, Yiba nofefe kuthi. Amen.

title: HAMBANI, ma-Kristu
lyrics: HAMBANI, ma-Kristu, Njengasemfazweni, Nne-krus' ka-Yesu Inikhokhela. Uyanandulela U-Krist' i-Nkosi, Nantsi seyiamba Eyakh' imikhosi.
Hambani, ma-Kristu,
Impi zika-Satan Ziyabaleka, Zakuva kugcotya Ngokukhalipa. Dumisani nonke Ngokuvakala Amandla entshaba Azakuphela.
I-Kenke ka-Thixo Inye kuphela, Bemkile abanye, Siyalandela, Sinto inye nabo, Ukwamny' umzimba, Ngokholo nothando Nangal' ithemba.
Ubukhosi nezizwe Zinesiphelo, I-Kenke ka-Yesu Iyakuhlala, Ayinakweyiswa Yimpi ka-Satan, Utshilo u-Kristu Ngezwi lenene.

Hambani ke, bantu, Ngantliziyo nye, Dumisan' u-Kristu I-Nkosi yethu, Makabongwe futhi 'Zithunywa nathi, Nguye yedw' omkhulu, Nguy' oyi-Nkosi. Hambani, ma-Kristu, Ngengasemfazweni, Nne-krus ka-Yesu Inikho kela. - Amen.

title: WATHUMA aba-Postile
lyrics: WATHUMA aba-Postile, Bahamba ngababini, Bashumayel' i-Vangeli, Bezindla-mafa kunye Zalo olofe fe lwakho, Abasebenza ngalo.
Siyakudumisa, Bawo, Ngalamagor' e-Vangeli, Owakhanyiselayo, Nkosi, Ngomhl' ovuth' uthando, Omnye uzalana nawe, Ngok' ukwazi ngenene.
U-Moya wakho okubo Ungowenz' izimanga, Wadala imiqondiso Mhla kwasekwa i-Bandla, Baliv' izwi lako, Nkosi, Kwakuvuk' intshutshiso.
Kusibekele kwakhona, Uthando luyabanda, Kwand' isono, lwaf' ukholo, Singenelwe zingcúka: Siza, Nkos' engu-Msindisi Ingafi inyaniso.
Yiba nenceba kuboni Khusel' abakholwayo, Masinyaniseke kuwe, Sikuncamele konke, Qinisa usomeleze 'De kube sekuferi.
'Ze kunye ne-Ngcwele zakho, U-Simone no-Yuda, Na-Bangcwele abalapho Sibonge sidumise, Kololwandle lwe-kristale, Zakuphela imfazwe.
Bawo, Thixo weth' omkhulu, Uzukiswa ngumhlaba, Nawe, Nkosi ya-Bangcwele, Wen' ofezekileyo, Nawe, Moya Oyingcwele, Sikubong' amax' onke. - Amen.

title: NGOBANINA bonke aba
lyrics: NGOBANINA bonke aba Bemi phambi ko-Thixo, Benxibile izitsaba, Bengumkhosi omkhulu? Aliluya! khanive, Bayabonga u-Thixo.
Ngobanina bonke aba Bekhazimla ngemhlope, Bezambethe izivatho Ezingcwel' ezimhlope, Bemsulwa kokomhlaba Bavela phina aba?
Nga-Bangcwele baka-Yesu, A'babemlulamela, Bebemkhonza yonk' imihla, Nokona bakudela, Boyisil' ekulweni, Bayaphuml' e-Zulwini.
Babelingwa ngobunzima, Bev' usiz' entliz'yweni, Noko lonk' ithemba labo Balibek' e-Nkosini, Ngoku baseluxolweni, Bonwabil' e-Zulwini.
Zizicaka zakhe ezi, Ezamkhonz' emhlabeni, Kwa ngomzimba nomphefumlo, Ebusuku, emini, Ngoku sebese-Zulwini, Banoyolo eNkosini. - Amen.

title: KUKH' umhlobo wabantwana
lyrics: KUKH' umhlobo wabantwana Ngaphaya kwelazulu, Lomhlobo ngohlala emi, Uthando lwakhe lumi, Ke abantu balomhlaba Baqqitha njengemihla, Lomhlobo ngohlala emi, Li-Gama lakudala.
Kukh' uphumlo lwabantwana Ngaphaya kwelazulu, Komthandayo u-Msindisi, Kothandaza ku-Yise, Luphumlo kwezinxwaleko, Kwisono nakwintsizi Nolutsh' olungabahambi Luphuml' unaphakade.
Kukh' ikhaya labantwana Ngaphaya kwelazulu, U-Yesu elawula apho, Likhaya lokonwaba, Alikho emhlaben' apha Elingafana nalo, Luvuyo lodwa kuphela, Akukho unomona.
Kukho indwe yabantwana Ngaphaya kwelazulu, Nabo bathemba u-Yesu Boyithweswa kamsinya, Iyabengezela yona, Iphiwa nguye kwabo Bazuze ufe fe apha, Bethanda nelo-Gama.
Kukh' ingoma yabantwana Ngaphaya kwelazulu, Yingoma enesikhono, Itsalele kude, le! Inqabela i-Ngelosi, Ukuba maziyazi Elethu lith, "A! Msindisi!" Elazo, "A! Kumkani!"
Kukh' ingubo yabantwana Ngaphaya kwelazulu, Nohadi lukhala mmandi, Nesebe lokweyisa, Bubuyebi nemivuyo Ku-Kristu yedwa apho, Nkosi, yiba nabantwana, Ube ngowabo kanye. - Amen.

title: NKOSI Thixo, sikubonga
lyrics: NKOSI Thixo, sikubonga, Ungowe-Zulu nomhlaba, Sokubonga, sokuthanda, Wen' ophayo.
Yonk' imisebenzi yakho Ixela uthando lwakho, Sivuna ngokupha kwakho, Wen' ophayo.
Nkosi, siyakubulela Ngoxolo nangokuphila, Uhlal' usisikelela, Wen' ophayo.
Sixolelw' izono zethu, Nguwe oli-Themba lethu, Wamkel' umnikelo wethu Wen' ophayo.
Oko sikunikelayo Kuyindyebo e-Zulwini, Sikunikela kumnandi, Wen' ophayo.
Sizuza konke okwethu Kuwe, Thixo Nkosi yethu, Sanga singahlala nawe, Wen' ophayo. - Amen.

title: YESU Kristu, Themba lethu
lyrics: YESU Kristu, Themba lethu, Sihlangene apha sonke, Size kuva i-Zwi Lakho, Yesu, yiba nathi namhla.
Yesu Kristu, Simakade, Mawusiphe intliziyo Ezikunxakameleyo Ukwamkel' i-lizwi Lakho.
Mawunik' umkhonzi Wakho, Ekufundiseni kwakhe, U-Muleki wokumnceda, Ongu-Moya Oyingcwele,
Asifundisise, sive Ngen tliziyo ezingcwele Ububele obukhulu Esisindiswayo ngabo.
Vusa intliziyo zethu, Zingalali ekoneni, Silamkel' i-lizwi Lakho Osishumayeza lona,
Siqinise silibambe Ngokuncedwa ngu-Muleki, Sifundiswe sihanjswe, Senze yonk' intando Yakho. - Amen.

title: THIXO, owadal' izulu
lyrics: THIXO, owadal' izulu Kwa nomhlaba, Waza wadala imini Nobusuku: Sithumele i-Ngelosi, Zisilinde sakulala, Ze siphuphe okungcwele, Ebuthongweni.
Sigcine ngamaxa onke, Nasekufeni, Ngokulondolozwa nguwe, Sisindiswe: Uz'ungasilahli, Thixo, Ngexilongo lokuphela, Ebungcwaliseni bakho Sibe nawe. - Amen.

title: SIPHAKAMIS' intliziyo
lyrics: SIPHAKAMIS' intliziyo Kuwe, Thix' osenyangweni, Kuba sesiku fumene Ukukhanya kwalemini.
Ngamana wasong' ilwimi Zethu kozimpikisano, Ukusel' ubomi bethu Kozingqumbo nozinkani.
Khusela amehlo ethu Ekubonen' amanyala, Kwa nasekukhangeleni Amasikiz' alomhlaba.
Yenza nyulu intliziyo Zethu ebubini bonke, Malibulawe ikratshi Ngesikwamkelayo kuwe.
'Ze kwakufika ukuhlwa Ufeziwe umsebenzi, Sisindil' ezilingweni Sikunik' uzuko, Thixo.
Udumiso kuwe, Thixo, Naku-Nyana ngokunjalo Naku-Moya Oyingcwele, Kude kus' ephakadeni. - Amen.

title: ICULO lombulelo nozuko
lyrics: ICULO lombulelo nozuko Siyaculela kuwe, Msindisi, Singekaphumi siyakubonga, Siguqel' izwi lakho loxolo.
Zusiphe sibe noxolo lwakho, Usihambise ngoncedo lwakho, Linda intliziyo ne milomo Ezithandazayo kuwe, Nkosi.
Zusiph' uxolo ngobubusuku, Bukhanyise ngokubakho kwakho, Usilwele kuzo zonk' ingozi, Wen' ongozeli y' ongalaliyo.
Zusiph' uxolo yonke imihla Usithuthuzele usixhase, Sakubizwa nguwe, singenise Kuxolo olungenakuphela. - Amen.

title: WAZITHWAL' izono, Yesu
lyrics: WAZITHWAL' izono, Yesu, Zingezono zaKho, Walhlawul' ityala, Yesu, Lingetyala laKho.
Wawungumntu onentsizi Ungemoni Wena Laphalal' igazi laKho, Uyingcwele Wena.
Iziphoso zethu zonke Zabalelwa kuWe. Nezilandu zethu zonke Zabalelwa kuWe.
Sixolelwa, siphiliswa, Ngezo ndungu zaKho, Siya hlanjwa ezonweni, Ngelo gazi laKho. - Amen.

title: ULIKHAYA lami
lyrics: ULIKAYA lami, Wena Jerusalem, Woba luphumlo lwam Ndakumk' emhlabeni: Azi ndoza Ndiye nini Kwikhaya lam, Ku-Thixo wam?
Ilaph' i-Nkosi yam, Engu-Kumkani wam, Kunye ne-Ngelosi Eziyinqulayo: Azi ndoza Ndiye nini Kwikhaya lam, Ku-Thixo wam?
Balaph' abadala Sebephumle bona Kwanaba-Profite, Ne-Tshawe loxolo: Azi ndoza Ndiye nini Kwikhaya lam, Ku-Thixo wam?
Kwanaba-Postile Be-Mvana ka-Thixo Balapho beyuma Ingoma zoyolo: Azi ndoza Ndiye nini Kwikhaya lam, Ku-Thixo wam?
Amafa-na-Nkosi Ndowabona nawo, Etsho ngezimhlope Ezizukileyo: Azi ndoza Ndiye nini Kwikhaya lam, Ku-Thixo wam?
Andaba ndikhona Andisekhon' apha Ndikhape ke, Nkosi, Ndi ye kwikhaya lam: Azi ndoza Ndi ye nini Kwikhaya lam, Ku-Thixo wam? - Amen.

title: NZULU yemfihlakalo
lyrics: NZULU yemfihlakalo! Nzulu yesimanga! Ezalise umhlaba, Nesibhaka-bhaka. Le nzulu yesimanga, NgokaThix' uNyana, Oweza ebantwini, Ngokubasindisa.
Wabon' uluntu lonke Luwe esonweni, Imiphefumlo yonke Ihlel' elishweni, Wasikwa yimfesane, Engumangaliso, Wathabathela ku Ye, Lonk' ihlazo labo.
Kwaba ngumangaliso Ukuzalwa kwaKhe, Waphila, wafundisa, Ngokuncamisayo. Waba ngumangaliso Umnqamlezo waKhe, Wafa, woyis' ukufa, Saba sisimanga.
Hayil obo bunzulu Bolu thando lwaKho Nalo msebenzi waKho Ongenakuqondwa. Abakholwayo namhla Abanakugwetywa, Ma wudunyiswe Nkosi, Kus' ephakadeni. - Amen.

title: NDIKHANGELE ngobubele
lyrics: NDIKHANGELE ngobubele, O Nkosi yam! Nguwe owabundifele, O Nkosi yam! Wehla ezulwini Lakho, Wabuncam' ubomi Bakho, Ndiva usindiso Lwakho, O Nkosi yam!
Be ndihleli emnyameni, O Nkosiyam! Be ndisinga ekufeni, O Nkosiyam! Zeza izicaka Zakho, Zandivisa izwi lakho, Zandityel' ufefe Lwakho, O Nkosiyam!
Ma ndiluv' ufefe Lwakho, O Nkosiyam! Ndibe lisindiswa Lakho, O Nkosiyam! Zonk' izono ma ziphele, Indiziyo ibe ngcwele. Yiva, undithethelele, O Nkosiyam! - Amen.

title: AKWABA se ndivuma
lyrics: AKWABA se ndivuma, Nangendiziyo yami, Ukwahlukana nayo, Inkohlakalo yami, Ndisuke ndiye ku Ye, OngumSindisi wami.
Akwaba ndinokuva Usizi emoyeni, Olona lusingisa Kwa seluguqukweni, Luhamba ngalo ndlela Iphela emgcobeni.
Akwaba ndinokholo Luqhub' umxhelo wami. Ndibambelele kuYe Ofe'l' ityala lami, Ndihlale ndithembela Kulo Mhlaw' leli wami.
Akwaba ndinamandla Avela eNkosini Ndikwale okomhlaba Ndibheke ezulwini. Ndivuselele, Thixo, Ndiphume ebubini. - Amen.

title: UKHANGELA kuwe
lyrics: UKHANGELA kuWe, Mvana yeKalvari, Ukholo lwam, Ndiva ndithandaza, Susa ityala lam, Kususela namhla, Ndenz' owaKho.
Ndinike amandla, Kwa nenzondelelo, So-lufe fe, Uthando lwam kuwe, Ma luvuthe nene, Ekubeni Wena Wandifela.
Ndisacand' udada Lwentlalo enzima, Ndikhokele. Khanyis' ubumnyama Sula inyembezi, Ma ndingaze ndimke KuWe, Ndlela.
Kwakuphel' ubomi, Kwakufik' ukufa, Ndivelele. Msindisi ngothando, Shenxis' uloyiko, Ndise ezulwini, Ndiphunyyuzwe. - Amen.

title: NKOSI yam, ubundithanda
lyrics: NKOSI yam, ubundithanda Ekulahlekeni kwam, Nkosi yam, waman’ ulanda Futhi emkhondweni wam. Ndafunyanwa, Nkosi yam.
Nkosi yam, ilizwi laKho Lingumkhanyiseli wam. Nkosi yam, ufele lwaKho Lusisonwabisa sam. Ndinovuyo, Nkosi yam.
Nkosi yam, uMoya wakho Uya ndingcwalisa nam. Nkosi yam, izulu lakho Lona lilikhaya lam. Ma ndingene, Nkosi yam. - Amen.

title: AMAHLATHI aphelile
lyrics: AMAHLATHI aphelile, Andisafunwa mntu, Ndilambile, Ndikhohliwe Apho ndingayayo.
Ndosuka ndiye kuBawo Ndithi kuYe: “Bawo, Okunene ndikonile, Buya undamkele.”
Andisafanele kanye, Ukubizwa ngawe, Ndo thi ni na, ndoya phi na? Buya undamkele.
Uz’ undenze isicaka Sasendlwini Yakho, Ze ndihlale ndikubona Buya undamkele.
’Nguwe endikonileyo Ndakutshikilela, Kodwa ngoku ndibuyayo, Buya undamkele.
Ubujacu endibubo Buya bonwa Nguwe, Noko se ndisiza nabo, Buya undamkele.
Bawo onenceba kanye, Uz’ ungandigxothi, Noko ndiliyaka-yaka Buya Undamkele. - Amen.

title: NDIKHOKELE
lyrics: NDIKHOKELE O Yehova! Ndingumhambi Nkosi yam, Unamandla andinawo, Unobuthathaka ndim. O Msindisi! Nguwe olikhaka lam.
Lowo mthombo wosindiso Owavulwa ngenxa yam, Ma uvele umpompóze Uzihlamb’ izono zam. O Msindisi! Nguwe oluncedo lwam.
Ndifikile eJordane, Susa izoyiko zam, Zundikhaphe, se ndiwela: Yiba nguMncedi wam. O Msindisi! Nguwe olithemba lam. - Amen.

title: MANDITHWALE iziqhamo
lyrics: MANDITHWALE iziqhamo, EzoMoya oyiNgcwele, Ubungcathu nolulamo, Ukulunga nobubele, Zonke ezizezenkolo, Nezothando, nezoxolo.
Ezi zinto ma zikhule Entlizyweni onk’ amaxa, Zindincede ndinyothule Konke oko kuzixaka Okwekratshi nokomona, Nento eziphuma khona.
Ewe, Nkosi, ma ndihlume, Ndibe ngoxakathileyo, Ndizamele, ndiphuthume Konke okulungileyo. Iz’ ingabi nakuphikwa Yonk’ imilo kwa nemikhwa. - Amen.

title: UNABANTU baKho, Thixo
lyrics: UNABANTU baKho, Thixo, Ngamaxesha onke, Ubagcina, ubancede, Endaweni zonke.
Bakuwela imilambo, Uba nabo Wena, Bakutshiswa ngemililo, Uba nabo Wena.
Apho batshutshiswa khona, Bomelezwa nguWe, Nasemaramncweni, Thixo, Bagciniwe nguwe.
Bakhangela kuWe, Nkosi, Abo bantu baKho, Babulela, bakuthembe, Abo bantu baKho. - Amen.

title: A! Lukhanyis' oluvela e-Zulwini
lyrics: A! Lukhanyis' oluvela e-Zulwini, Luka-Yise ongenakonakala, Ngcwele yengcwele, Yesu Kristu Nkosi.
Se' lixa lokuphumla kwelanga, Kukhany' imililo yokuhlwa, Sibonga Wena, Yise, Nyana, Moya Ongcwele.
Ufanel' ukubongw' amaxa onke Ngamazwi anyulu, Thixo, Nyana, Mniki wobom wedwa! Ngoko kulo lonke bavuma Wena, Nkosi.-Amen.

title: USIZI nalu lumi lodwa
lyrics: USIZI nalu lumi lodwa, Iintlungu nazi zimi zodwa, Nab' ububele bumi bodwa, Emnqamlezweni.
I-Nkosi yehla ezulwini, Eyaba ngumntu ebantwini, Yenzelwa thina bon' indini, Emnqamlezweni.
Ukholo lwethu loma phi na ? Ithemba lethu loma phi na ? Uthando lwethu loma phi na ? Emnqamlezweni.
Ingozi ingaphela yonke, Ityala liya hlaw'lwa lonke, Izono zoxolelwa zonke, Emnqamlezweni.
Zibona iingelosi phantsi, Ziqwalasele futh' ezantsi, Zibona isimanga, nasi! Emnqamlezweni. - Amen.

title: MAZITH' iingqondo zethu
lyrics: MAZITH' iingqondo zethu, Zimbonge u Yehova, Kuba iinceba zaKhe, Zimi ngonaphakade.
Ma sithi kulo lonke, Sazis' igama lakhe, Kuba iinceba zaKhe, Zimi ngonaphakade.
Ngawo amandla aKhe, Ukhanyisel' ilizwe, Kuba iinceba zaKhe, Zimi ngonaphakade.
Wondla izinto zonke, Ngaso isandla saKhe, Kuba iinceba zaKhe, Zimi ngonaphakade.
Ezintsizini zethu, Iliso liya bona, Kuba iinceba zaKhe, Zimi ngonaphakade.
Kubo bonke oothixo, Akukho onje ngaYe, Kuba iinceba zaKhe, Zimi ngonaphakade. - Amen.

title: PHEZU komhlaba ngamazwe ngamazwe
lyrics: PHEZU komhlaba ngamazwe ngamazwe, Phezu komhlaba zizizwe ngezizwe, Apho iintetho zahluka-hlukayo, Apho maninz'amasiko enziwayo.
Kodwa nangona zahluka-hlukayo, Kukho indawo zihlangana ngayo, Zonke izizwe zihlel'ezonweni, Zonke izizwe zotshon'ekufeni.
Apha ngaphantsi uncedo alukho, Apha ngaphantsi ubomi abukho, Phaya phezulu silangazelela, Apho uMncedi wa boni wovela.
Yesu, inguWe onokusindisa, Yesu, inguWe onokuphilisa, Se sithembele kwawaKho amandla, Se sibambile esaKho isandla.
Wena, wafela aboni bomhlaba, Wena, wazisa izizwe iindaba Yiba nodumo, kumazwe ngamazwe, Yiba nodumo, kwizizwe ngezizwe. - Amen.

title: BAWO, ngobubele bakho
lyrics: BAWO, ngobubele bakho Bona umphemlo wam, Ndiya lila phambi kwakho, Susa zonk'izono zam.
Ndikho ebusweni bakho, Zungalahli izwi lam, Ndiphe uxolelo lwakho, Susa zonk'izono zam.
Nkosi yam, andikaneli, Yiva ukubiza kwam, Wen'ungendibandezeli, Susa zonk'izono zam.
Nkosi, Bawo, ndingcolile, Hlanza intliziyo yam, Ngezi zono ndidanile, Susa zonk'izono zam. - Amen.

title: ABABEHLEL' emnyameni
lyrics: ABABEHLEL' emnyameni Bayakhanyiselwa, Abakwithunzi lokufa Babon'ukukhanya
Intlanga zintontelana Zibulis' i-Nkosi, Zivuya ngokwabavuni Bethwel' amasinde.
Kuba ubathul' umthwalo, Wayichith' ingqwemla, Njengamhlana yenzwanjalo Impi yakwa-Mid'yan.
Kuba sizalelw' u-Mntwana, Siphiwe u-Nyana: Amandla aphezu kwalo Igxalaba lakhe.
Ngu-Mthetheli-xol' i-Gama, I-Nkos' yaphakade, U-Simanga, u-Mcebisi, U-Thix' onqulwayo.
Amandla nolawulo lwakhe Lusayakunaba, Lusekwe ngobulungisa, Alunakuphela.
Yesu lawula kuthi Wena, Usenze abakho, Uhleli u-Mnye no-Yise No-Moy' oyiNgcwele. - Amen.

title: BAWO! xa ndilahlekayo
lyrics: BAWO! xa ndilahlekayo Kolu hambo lweli lizwe Hlal' undifundis' ukuthi: "Ma yenzek' intando yaKho."
Olu hambo luneengozi, Olu hambo luneentshaba, Zezithunywe nguWe zonke, "Ma yenzek' intando yaKho."
Xenikweni wandihlutha Into endiyithandayo, Ndoba ndibuyis' eyaKho "Ma yenzek' intando yaKho."
Ndakuhliwa nasisifo Onk' amandla am ahluthwe Ndakuzama, Baw' ukuthi,- "Ma yenzek' intando yaKho."
Yiguqul' eyam intando, Yifanise nay' eyaKho, Susa konke ukukrokra, "Ma yenzek' intando yaKho." - Amen.

title: THIXO, akunangqaleko
lyrics: THIXO, akunangqaleko, Thixo akunangqibeko Ukho endaweni zonke Ukho ngamaxesha onke.
Phaya ezinkwenkwezini Ukho Wena, ezulwini Wab'ukade sel'ukhona Xa zingekabikho zona.
Zoda zigqibeke zonke, Kuthi tshabalala konke, Ube Wena Ungapheli, Ube Wena usahleli. - Amen.

title: HE, mamelan' l'ingoma yengelosi
lyrics: HE, mamelan' l'ingoma yengelosi, Ivakala phezu kwamathafa, Hay'inene yezongoma zoyolo, Ngobutsh'ubom kwaphel'isono! Ngelos'qo-Yesu nokukhanya, Culelani abahamb'ebusuku.
Xa siziva, sibhekisa phambili Zithi, "Bantu, nibizwa ngu-Yesu"
Kobu mnyama siva intsholo yazo, Silandel'ingoma yevangeli. Ngelos'qo-Yesu nokukhanya, Culelani abahamb'ebusuku.
Le, kude le, njengentsimbi zokuhlwa, Kuvakala izwi lika-Yesu, Kucothoza nezihlwele zaboni, Malusi, baguqulele kuwe. Ngelos'qo-Yesu nokukhanya, Culelani abahamb'ebusuku.
Nok'obubom bubude, bunentsizi, Nezimini zisithokothoko, Zakudlula kofika ukuphumla Okungapheliyo e-Zulwini. Ngelos'qo-Yesu nokukhanya, Culelani abahamb'ebusuku.
Zi-Ngelosi, lindani ke nicule Ingoma zaphezul'e-Nkosini, Kosa uvuyo, kuphel'ukulila, Kubek'uthand'olungapheliyo. Ngelos'qo-Yesu nokukhanya, Culelani abahamb'ebusuku. - Amen.

title: I-NKOS' ivukile
lyrics: I-NKOS'ivukile, Ifezile konke: Likweyisile ukufa Igo? elikhulu.
I-Nkos'ivukile, Hades, udanile! Ivuka nabakululwa, Eyakubalawula.
I-Nkos'ivukile, Ayisokub'ife: Icamagushel'aboni, Eyabafelayo.
I-Nkos'ivukile, Yivani, Zithunywa! Zivakalisen'e-Zulwini Indaba zovuyo.
Iphin'imirubhe? Bethani ngovuyo' Kunye nomkhosi we-Zulu: I-Nkos'ivukile. - Amen.

title: KOBUBUNJE bam, ndingento
lyrics: KOBUBUNJE bam, ndingento Kodwa kuba wandifela, Waye ke undibiza, Nkosi, Ndiyeza ngoko, Nkosi.
Kobubunje bam, nakuba Ndidlavuwe yimizamo, Ngaphandle nangaphakathi, Ndiyeza ngoko, Nkosi.
Kobubunje bam, ndiswele, Ndaphukile, ndiyimfama, Ndifuna usizo kuwe, Ndiyeza ngoko, Nkosi.
Kobubunje bam ndosizwa, Wondamkel' undixolele , Ngenxa yelodinga lakho Ndiyeza ngoko, Nkosi.
Kobubunje bam, ngothando Iwakho olungaziwayo, Ukuba ndibe ngowakho, Ndiyeza ngoko, Nkosi.
Kobubunje bam, ndingento, Ndize kuva ubukhulu Balo olothando lwakho, Ndiyeza ngoko, Nkosi. - Amen.

title: KUSUSELA ku-Baptizo
lyrics: KUSUSELA ku-Baptizo, Mhla saphiw' ubomi bakho, Bawo, sazalwa ngokutsha, Singabakho abantwana.
Sesikhulile ke ngoku, Sesingabo bavavanywa Ngozilingo nozingozi, Mbandiswe obobomi.
Ke, namhla nje, ngenyameko, Siyazicelel' amandla Ize sikuchas' okubi, Senze nokulungileyo.
Lomandl' eza, athululwa Kuwo ummisei ongcwele, Ngok' uzalisiwe njalo Umsebenzi wo-Baptizo.
Kuthe, sakubekw' izandla Ngonegunya laba-Postile, Wehl' u-Moya, saba ngoko Ngamalungu azeleyo.
Momelezi, M-ngcw alisi, Thina zi-tempile zakho Thamsanqela, ube kuthi: Soba ngabalawulwa nguwe.
Ongu-Yise mzukiseni, Nongu-Nyana, ngokunjalo, Nimzukis' u-Moya lowo Osiveleleyo namhla. - Amen.

title: KWA kusasa into zonke
lyrics: KWA kusasa into zonke Zibulela, Nkosi, kuwe, Kuba unobomi bonke, Nathi sigciniwe nguwe.
He! ilanga liphumela Ukuhamb' indlela yalo, Nali! liyasixelela, Iithi, uyi-Nkosi yalo.
Nalemini ibivela, Yaba nokukhanya kwayo, Nantsi! nayo iyatyela, Ithi, ungu-Menzi wayo.
Namazulu ajikela, Emi anenkonzo yawo: Nanga! ayashumayela, Athi, ungu-Mgcini wawo.
Zonk' izilo zikhangela Kuwe kwa ngokutya kwazo, Ngathi zitsho: Ziyacela Kuwe ongu-Mdali wazo.
Sothi ngoko, Bawo wethu, Sikubonge sibulele, Kunye no-Mkhululi wethu, Nay'u-Moya Oyingcwele. - Amen.

title: KWELA! kwela ngobukosi!
lyrics: KHWELA! khwela ngobukhosi! Ubuliswa zizwe zonke, Yandlaliw'indlela yako Ngamagqabi nangengubo.
Khwela! khwela ngobukhosi! M-Sindisi wolulamo, Condobeza ukuhamba, Uye kuhle ekufeni.
Khwela! khwela ngobukhosi! Wena, Kristu, qala ngoku Ukoyisa ababambi, Ukuf'oku kwa nesono.
Khwela! khwela ngobukhosi! Kukhangelwe zi-Ngelosi, Zilijonge kalusizi Elo-Dini elizayo.
Khwela! khwela ngobukhosi! Imfazw'embi ikufuphi, Nank'u-Yise e-Troneni Elindel'u-Nyana wake.
Khwela! khwela ngobukhosil Yiza kuhle ekufeni, Buthobele ubuhlungu, Uz'ubuy'uphathe, Thixo. - Amen.

title: MALUSI oyintanda
lyrics: MALUSI oyintanda Gcina imvana yako, Akoyiswa nto Wena Andingehluthwa Kuwe
M-Sindisi oyintanda, Wafa 'kuze siphile Uzolule izandla Ukub'usikelele.
Ndohlala ndikubonga, Ndenze intando Yakho, Njengabo baphezulu, Behleli ngokonwaba.
Sondela, Malusi wam, Mandiliv'i-Zwi lakho, Ndize ndingaphambuki Kulendlela imxinwa.
Ndohamba ngendlel'akho, Ngokukhokelwa nguwe, Ndide ndiye ngakuyo I-Terone ka-Bawo. - Amen.

title: NDIMTHANDA u-Msindisi wam
lyrics: NDIMTHANDA u-Msindisi wam, Ngokuba engu-Mhlobo wam, Wandenzela uxolo lwam Phakathi kwam no-Thixo wam.
Ndimthanda u-Msindisi wam, Ngokuba engu-Mcoci wam, Uyazisus' izono zam, Ohlambe intliziyo yam.
Ndimthanda u-Msindisi wam, Ngokuba eku'khanya kwam, O-lizwi lisibane sam, Likhanyisel' indlela yam.
Ndimthanda u-Msindisi wam, Ngokuba engu-Mncedi wam, Unam nasebutsheni bam, Nasekwaluphaleni kwam.
Ndimthanda u-Msindisi wam, Ngokuba engamandla am, Undoyisel' intshaba zam, Ulawula ngaphakhati kwam.
Ndimthanda u-Msindisi wam, Uhlal' ehleli Yena nam, Zakumka izihlobo zam, Useko ebubomi bam. - Amen.

title: WAKRAZULWA ngenxa yami
lyrics: WAKRAZULWA ngenxa yami, Liwa laphakade! Kuze ndizifihle kuWe, Nxeba likaYesu!
Yeyani na le mikrozo, Kwelo cala laKho? Yeyegazi, yeyamanzi, Ma ndihlanjululwe.
Inyembezi zeminyaka, Azinge feze nto, NguWe, Nkosi, osusayo Zonk izono zomntu.
Andinanto esandleni, Ndize kanye, Nkosi, Se ndondele ekrusini, Ekube thelweni.
Wakrazulwa ngenxa yami, Liwa laphakade! Kuze ndizifihle kuWe, Nxeba likaYesu! - Amen.

title: NDIZA kuwe, Wena Mvana
lyrics: NDIZA kuwe, Wena Mvana, Ndingenazwi kuphel' eli- Wandophela, wandifela, Wandibiza ndize kuwe.
Ndiza kuwe, Wena Mvana, Wen' o-Gazi lisulayo Konke okungcolileyo, Kungasali nechaphaza.
Ndiza kuwe, Wena Mvana, Andilindi kuzihlamba Ngamandla am nakwesinye Isonwana entliz' yweni.
Ndiza kuwe, Wena Mvana, Ndiludway' oluyimfama, Uphiliso nokubona Ndivukele zona kuwe. - Amen.

title: NGCWELE, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, unamandla onke
lyrics: NGCWELE, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, unamandla onke, Ungu Thixo wedwa, uyi Nkosi yaphezulu. Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, unenceba yonke, Ungu Bawo wethu wena, unguy' uYehova.
Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Mdali wamanyange, Usahleli, wohlal'ukho, ngamaxesha onke, Usithele thina, akunakwaziwa, Ubathathu Umnye, Wena, Nkos'edunyiswayo.
Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, amabandla Akho Aya kudumisa Wena, Awe phambi Kwakho, Ziya kuzukisa nengelosi Zakho, Ezihlala zikhanyiswa kukukhanya Kwakho.

Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, unamandla onke, Udunyiswa, Uzukiswa, zizidalwa zonke, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, unofefe lonke, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, ubathathu umnye. UnguThixo umnye Wena, ubathathu umnye. Amen.

title: JERUSALEM, wena Khaya
lyrics: JERUSALEM, wena Khaya, Khaya elimnandi, Wobonwa na, ungenwe na Ngonjengam umoni?
Emhlaben' akukho ndawo Iyole njengawe, Kuthw' abemi bakho bonke Bakholiwe nguwe.
Kuthw' intsizi kuw' azikho, Kwa nembandezelo, Kuthw' indlala nenyembezi Kuwe ziphelile.
Baphilile bonwabile Abakuhleliyo, Baxolile bayaphumla Ngokungapheliyo.
Khaya lethu lo-Msindisi, Ndiyakukhumbula, Khaya lethu lika-Thixo, Ndiyakunqwenela.
Azi ulikhaya nje na, Ndiyakukuma na ? Azi undibiza nje na, Ndoza ndifike na ?
Ukho owondingenisa, Lowo ngu-Mphilisi, Ukho owondifikisa, Lowo ngu-Msindisi - Amen.

title: NGOBHAPTIZO olungcwele
lyrics: NGOBHAPTIZO olungcwele Senziwa amalungu Omzimba we-Nkos', i-Kerike , Simanyene nayo.
Ngenene, sinto nye naye Oyintoko Yena, Osiphilis' esixhasa Ngobake ubomi.
Ngokumiliselwa kuye Hayi ukuphakama Kwendlal' esiyinikwayo- Yeyase-Zulwini !
Sibaninzi simzimba mnye Ngalo-Moya umnye, Obabalay' amalungu Ngokwahlulelana.
Akwab' amalungu akho Avan' onke, Nkosi, Ibe ntle le-Ngubo yakho, Ingenasikroba.
Yihla, uze, Moy'Ongcwele, Usibumbe sonke, Sibe ngumzimb'omnye kanye Way'i-Nkosi inye. - Amen.

title: NGOBUSUKU benkatazo
lyrics: NGOBUSUKU benkathazo, Benyembezi nentsizi, Amaqela abahambi, Abhekisa phambili.
Ehamba nje akayeki Ukuvuma ingoma, Zamathemba elolizwe Aya kulo, le-Kanan.
Phambi kwethu kukhokela Isibane se-Zulu, Amakholwa axakene, Ahamba emnyameni.
Lunye ukhanyiso lwabo Abangabakhululwa, Kukubakho kuka-Thixo, Osithoba imvalo.
Simanyene koluhambo, Simanyene ngokholo, Simanyene ethembeni Esonikwa ngu-Thixo.
Simanyene engomeni Evunywa ngamawaka, Simanyene kwelidabi Linengozi ezimbi.
Simanyene ngemivuyo Sakuwele-Yoredan, Aph'u-Bawo wethu sonke Aphetheyo ngothando.
Nyathelani ngesibindi Ngoko ke, bazalwana, Ntlw'imfazwe yomnqamlezo, Nfe niphantsi kwayo.
Kukufuphi ukuvuka, Ukrazuko lwengcwaba, Ukumka kwalamathunzi, Ukuphela kosizi. - Amen.

title: NIYABIZWA, bantu nonke
lyrics: NIYABIZWA, bantu nonke, Ngu-Mkhululi wenu, Uthi, "Yizani kum nonke, Nemithwalo yenu".
Unamandla onke Yena Okunikhulula, Unenceba yonke Yena, Anganixolela.
Yesu, amatyala ethu Uz'uwaxolele. Yiva umthandazo wethu, Usisikelele.
Hlamba intliziyo zethu Ngelo-Gazi lakho, Yomelez'ukholo lwethu, Ngalo-Moya wakho.
Masikonze Wena ngoko Apha emhlabeni, Side size phambi kwakho Apho e-Zulwini. - Amen.

title: PHEZULU komkhulu, Thixo
lyrics: PHEZULU komkhulu, Thixo, Luxolo noyolo, Nengoma zabazukisa Ubukhulu bakho.
Nantso !im'i-Tfone yakho, Iphahlwe ngezabo Abadala , ziqqamba Izivatho zabo.
Ngokunjalo ezo zinto Eziphilileyo, Ezo zine, ziqubuda Zinenkonzo zazo.
Neziganga ze-Ngelosi Zimi, intlu ngentlu , Ziyondela ngaku-Mdali, Zihleli zimkhonza.
Nemikhosiya bangcwele, Ingangenkwenkwezi, Ikho nayo , beyisile, Sebesiv'inyweba.
Ngezw' elinye ziyabonga Zonk' ezizidalwa Zithi, "U-Ngcwele yengcwele Ufanel' imbeko."
"Uzuko nokomelela, Nay' imibulelo , Owayekho, osekhoyo Onk' amaphakade."
Phezulu komkhulu lakho Yimihlali yodwa, Nemibongo, kuzukiswa U-MTrinit' Ongcwele. - Amen.

title: UHLELI yen' u-Yesu
lyrics: UHLELI yen' u-Yesu ! Kufa, asisakoyiki, Uhleli ! sazi ngoko, Ngcwaba, akusenamandla. Aliluya !
Uhleli kuz'ukufa Kube lisango lobomi : Oku kosiph'uxolo, Sakulul' emnyango wakho. Aliluya!
Uhlelil wasifela, Nathi siphilela Yena, Sibe ngcwel' entliz' yweni, Simdumise u-Mkhululi. Aliluya!
Uhleli! ngokwenene Asinakwahlulwa kuye, Saye sigcinwe nguye Ebomini, ekufeni. Aliluya!
Uhlelil selenikwe Lonk'igunya emhlabeni, Singa singamlandela, Sibe naye e-Zulwini. Aliluya! - Amen.

title: UMSEBENZ' ugqityiwe
lyrics: UMSEBENZ' ugqityiwe Walomzalwana wethu, Idabi selidule, Nanko engaphesheya. Simshiyela kuwe, Bawo la ulele kulendawo.
Apho kusulw inyembezi, Kutiyilw'imfihlakalo, U-Mgweb' olilungisa Ugweb' izenzo zethu. Sim shiyela kuwe, Bawo, Lo ulele ku lendaw o.
Kulaph' imiphefumlo Yabajong' e-kruseni Yazana nolothando Luka-Kristu, e-Hades. Sim shiyela kuwe, Bawo, Lo ulele ku lendaw o.
Aph' amandl' esiho go Akasaphazamisi, Kub'i-Nkos' ilikhusi, Eyabakhululayo Sim shiyela kuwe, Bawo, Lo ulele ku lendaw o.
"Umhlaba emhlabeni Uthul' eluthulini," Simshiya elindele Lomhl' omkhulu wovuko. Sim shiyela kuwe, Bawo, Lo ulele ku lendaw o. - Amen.

title: UNGCWELE yengcwele zonke
lyrics: UNGCWELE yengcwele zonke Makanikw'udumo Kweziphezulu indawo, Nakwezingaphantsi.
Wamthumel'u-Nyana wakho Apha elizweni, Waba nguMkhululi wethu, Kwezizono zethu.
Weyiswa yena u-Adam, Hayi kodwa Yena Uloyisile utshaba, Hayi uthando lwakhe!
Sifumene Wena ngenqu, Ubu-Thixo bakho, Ngalo-Nyama nelo-Gazi Ulwileyo ngalo.
Lunabil'uthando lwakho Osithande ngalo, Ngenthungu ozivileyo, Uzivela thina.
Weyana nenthungu Wena E-Getseman Wasishiya nomzekelo Ngokwakho ukufa.
U-Ngcwele yengcwele zonke Makanikw'udumo Kweziphezulu indawo, Nakwezingaphantsi. - Amen.

title: VUMAN' amandla ka-Yesu
lyrics: VUMAN' amandla ka-Yesu, Zithunywa, yiwani, Mtheni-ijze ngesitsaba: Mthwesen'ubukhosi.
Mthweseni, makhwez'omso, Ummisi womhlaba, Vuman'ubukhosi bakhe: Mthwesen'ubukhosi.
Nani ninga-Mafa-na-Nkosi, Emiphambi kwe-Trone, Bongan' i-Ngcambu ka-Isayi: Mthwesen'ubukhosi.
Nina, nzala ka-Yakobi, Enikhululweyo, Vuman'ubukhosi bakhe: Mthwesen'ubukhosi.
Nina mlibo ka-Davide, Uyi-Nkosi yenu, Ongu-Thixo ekwangumntu, Mthwesen'ubukhosi.
Nina baginwa, yiwani Kwezonyawo zakhe, Ezizele ngamanxeba: Mthwesen'ubukhosi.
Mazithi zonke intlanga, Zimthobele Yena, Zivum'ubukhosi bakhe Zimthwes'ubukhosi. - Amen.

title: YESU, besikulahlile
lyrics: YESU, besikulahlile, Kanti Wen'ubusifele, Kodwa namhla sidanile: Mawubuye usamkele.
Asisafanele thina Ukwenzelwa izibele, Kodwa siyakuthi-nina? Mawubuye usamkele.
Sinezono ezikhulu, Namhla zisibandezele, Sikhangela ngaphezulu: Mawubuye usamkele.
Nkosi, Yesu, siyahl'a, Thina sikukhedamele, Sililel'eleth'ityala: Mawubuye usamkele. - Amen.

title: IMFUNDISO ka Yehova
lyrics: IMFUNDISO ka Yehova Ichaphaza nje ngemvula, Intethiso ka Yehova Ihlaziya nje ngombethe.
Ingqeqesho ka Yehova Ivuyisa indiziyo, Nje ngovuyo lwesiphango, Phezu kwengca ehlumayo.
Inkokelo ka Yehova Inje ngokhoz' olukhulu, Wabathwal' oobawo bethu Ukubasa kwelo khaya.
Uliliwa u Yehova, Kubo bonk'abantu Bakhe. Nguye umkhuseli Wabo Kuzo zonk'indlela zabo.
Yo! akwaba singalumka, Yo! akwaba singaqonda. Size sithi sakufika Ezulwini, sifezeke. - Amen.

title: YESU se ndivumile
lyrics: YESU se ndivumile Ukukhonza Wena, Zuhlale ukufuphi, Nkosi nomhlobo wam. Andikoyik' ukulwa, Usecaleni kwam, Ndingeyilah'l' indlela Xa ungu-Mgcini wam.
Mandiv' ubukho bakho, Umhlab' uhlel' ukho, Ndingqongwe zizinto 'Ziphazamisayo. Intshaba zam zihleli Phakathi naphandle Yesu, Nkosi, sondela Undigcine kuzo.
Zundivise ngelozwi Livakala kuhle Phezu kwesisa qhwiti Sekratshi nenkani Thetha, undomeleze, Thetha, undinqande, Thetha, ndiphulaphule, Mgcini-mpe fumlo wam.
Yes', ubathembisile Abo bangabakho, Apho ukhona Wena Boba khona nabo. Ke, Yesu, ndivumile Ukukhonza Wena, Z'undiphe ubabalo, Ndilandele Wena.
Mandihambe indlela Emyathelwe nguwe, Ukulungelelsa Kusemandlen'akho. Ndikhokele, ndibize, Ndixhase kuphele, Undamkel'e-Zulwini, Msindisi, Mhlobo wam. - Amen.

title: Z'UHLALE nam ngoku litshona nje
lyrics: Z'UHLALE nam ngoku litshona nje Z'uhlale nam ngexesha lokuhlwa, Ndakuyekelwa ngabancedi bam, Mcholi wenkedama, z'uhlale nam.
Lihle litshone ilanga le thu, Buphele msinya ubuyol'obu, Akumi nent'endiyibonayo, O Simakade, uz'uhlale nam.
Ndumemba Wena zonke ezimini Ndosinda ngwe, Nosi, ku-Satan, Wena Mkhokheli, Wena Mkhosi wam, Lisibekele, uz'uhlale nam.
Andoyik'impi, Wena ukho oje, Andisindwa bubi nazintsi, Ukufa akusenabuhlungu, Ndimokuphila, xa uhleli nam.
Yimis'i-knus', ameh'l'ahuzizi, Ndalahisele kuw'e-Zulwini, Kuyasa, buyemka ubumnyama, Nasekufeni, Nosi, z'uhlale nam. - Amen.

title: UMKHULULI esahleli
lyrics: UMKHULULI esahleli, Engekanyukeli, Wasithembis'u-Mkhokheli, Abe nathi.
Weza kuthi elundwendwe, Efun'intliziyo Ezingamnika indawo Yokuphumla
Uhleli nath'entliz'yweni, Xa simphulaphula, Eluleka, esityela Okwe-Zulu.
Bonk'obethu ubungcwele Nezoyiso zonke Nenkumbulo ezingcwele, Zizezakhe.
Moya wofefe nenene, Zusihlambulule, Size sifanele Wena Ngobungcwele. - Amen.

title: EYASENYANGWENI i Sabata
lyrics: EYASENYANGWENI i-Sabata Iyolis' abasikelelweyo, Bayaphumla abadiniweyo, Bayavuzwa abakrotileyo.
Banoxolo banovuyo bona Abangenako ukuluxela, Nekomkhulu lo-Kumkani wabo Lisionwabiso sabo bona.
Yerusalem, Sixeko soxolo, Kwabo bamhandaz'ungapheliyo, 'Ze bade babe bakufumene Oko bakucamagushele yoyo.
Sovuma ingoma ezimnandi Ezase-Tsiyone yaphezulu, Bokudumisa nabannu bakho, Ngenxa yal'ufefe lwakho, Nkosi.
Ayipheli i-Sabata khona, Inye eyamakholwa akhona, Nengoma yakhona ayipheli, Sodlelana ngayo ne-Ngelosi.
Okwakaloku masixunele Kwelozwe siphongomele lona, I-Yerusalem, ikhaya lethu, Sisekwe li lokuphambukela.
Siwa phambikwakho sizukisa Wena, Mdali wazo zonk' izinto, Yise, no-Nyana, no-Moy' Ongcwele, Nibanye kuse ephakadeni. - Amen.

title: MAKUBE ngokwako
lyrics: MAKUBE ngokwakho Ukuhanda, Nkos, Ndinyulel' indlela Endobamba yona.
Nokub'injanina, Yeyona iyiyo, Yeyondibhekisa Kolona luphumlo.
Ndingezinyuleli Eyon' ithandwa ndim, Ndinyulele Wena Ze ndingalahleki
Okunqwenelwa ndim, Kokwakho, Thixo wam, Nendlela mayibe Kwa yeyakho nayo.
Nokokuba uthe Mandibe nentsizi, Nokuba buyolo- Kokwakho konk'oko.
Mandizinyulelwe Nguwe nezihlobo, Nokuba sisifo Nokuba 'kuphila.
Ukunyul' asikwam, Umkhokeli nguwe, Yiba ngamandla am Ube 'nto zonke kum. - Amen.

title: BONYANA bam, zintombi zam
lyrics: Ailuya! Ailuya! Ailuya!
BONYANA bam, zintombi zam, I-Nkosi yobuqaqawuli Ivukile kumanyange! Ailuya!
U-Madelina, no-Mari Ka-Yakobi, no-Salome, Beza kumthambis' u-Yesu. Aliluya!
I-Sithunywa sasihleli, Sithe-wamb' ingub' emhlope, Sath', "Uvukil', akakw' apha." Aliluya!
Xa babehlanganisene, Gqi! yatsho phakathi, yathi, "Uxolo malube nani." Aliluya!
U-Tomas, akuv' ukuba Bayibonile i-Nkosi, Wathi, "Andisokukholwa." Aliluya!
"Tomas, bona izandla zam, Fak' esakho ecaleni, Ungabi ngongakholwayo." Aliluya!
Xana wabonay' u-Tomas Icala nezandla zakhe, Wathi, "Nkosi yam, Thixo wam!" Aliluya !
Kwabathe bengabonanga Bakholwa noko, luyolo, Banobomi baphakade. Aliluya !
Ngumhla wovuy'olukhulu, Ewenziley'i-Nkos'ethu: Siyagcoba nathi ngawo ! Aliluya ! - Amen.

title: UMYENI uyafika
lyrics: “UMYENI uyafika,” Kuthiwa manivuke, Nye kumkhawulela, Selesondele. Uzakufika, Yesu, Uzeke umtshakazi- Kwa i-Kenike yakho, Emsulwa entle.
Akumzekanga Wena Ngenkomo lomtshakazi: Igazi lakho Yesu, Iophela yena, Ngoku fa wamfumana, Wamkhupha ku-Satana, Abe ngowakho wedwa, Umhlambulule.
Ilapha le-Kerike, Ihleli emhlabeni, Mawusincede, Nkosi, Ngo fefe lwakho, Sinamathele kuyo, Singawi ezonweni, Sikhutshwe zizo kuyo, Slahlwe nguwe.
Selusondele, Yesu, Uzaku fika kuthi, Kuthiwa masivathe Sikuhlonele, Izandla zibe mhlope, Imhlope nentiziyo, Size singene kuwo Umthato nawe.
Uvuyo lwalomtshato Aluqondeki apha, Akukho ndlebe yamntu Eyeva ngaio, Akukho liso lamntu Hakha lalubona, Lulungiselwe abo Bakuthandayo,
Ucango lwako, Nkosi, Lusavulelwe thina! Ilizwi lokumema Lisavakala, Masiliphulaphule, Sambathe ubungcwele, Singene kulomtshato, Sivuye nawe. - Amen.

title: PHEZULU eNkosini
lyrics: PHEZULU eNkosini, Ngabalungile bodwa, Phezulu eZulwini, Kuhlel' ingcwele zodwa.
Ofun' ukuya khona, Ma kazithandazele, Alungiselwe lona NguMoya oyiNgcwele
UYesu usifele, Kuphel' iyala lethu, Iz' ithi ibe ngcwele Nemiphefumlo ye thu.
Ukuze sakuhliwa Kukufa emhlabeni, Sngabi nakwaliwa Ukuya eZulwini. - Amen.

title: YISABATHA namhla, Nkosi
lyrics: YISABATHA namhla, Nkosi, Iyi mini Yakho, Baya vuy'abantu Bakho Ngale mini Yakho.
Wawuphuma namhla, Nkosi, Engcw abeni Lakho, Waku fis'ukufa namhla Ngokuvuka Kwakho.
Uvukile Wena, ntloko Yabo bakholwayo. Sakuvuka nathi ngoko, Thina sikholwayo.
Ma liviwe ilizwi Lakho Ngabaninzi namhla, Ma bavuswe ekufeni, Babe Nawe namhla.
Sibulela Wena, Yesu, Kuyo lendlu Yakho, Sinezinto zonke thina, Ngokuvuka Kwakho. - Amen.

title: NGCWELE, Ngcwele, Ngcwele
lyrics: NGCWELE, Ngcwele, Ngcwele! Thixo So-Mandla Kwakusasa siyakuculela Kuwe Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, ! Wen' onobubele! Ziqu zithathu, Thixo M-Triniti !
Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, ! Wen' odunyiswayo Ngabangcwele bonke Abase-Zulwini, Bathi Bekubonga Bawe phambi Kwakho, Ohlal' uhleli ngonaphakade
Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele, ! Ufihlakele Thina boni singenakukubona nje, Nguwe wedw'ongcwele, kungekho Wumbi nje Ufezekile ngendawo zonke
Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele! Thixo Somandla! Udunyiswa Wena misebenzi Yakho Ngcwele, Ngcwele, Ngcwele! Onofefe lonke! Ziqu zithathu, Thixo M-Triniti - Amen.

title: MA ndiyenze indumiso
lyrics: MA ndiyenze indumiso, Enkosini yosindiso, Yandenzela imvuyiso, Se ndivuyile, Mkhululi wam!
Ndandihleli ezonweni, Ndandibanjwe etyaleni, Ndandisiya emliweni, Wandisindisa, Mkhululi wam!
Wandivisa izwi lakho, Wandidlis'ufe fe lwakho, Ndize ndibe ngumnw'an'akho, Se ndibulela Mkhululi wam!
Wandikhupha entsizini, Wandibeka ebomini, Sendisinga e zulwini, Ngo fe fe lwakho, Mkhululi wam! - Amen.

title: EYONA nt'inexabiso
lyrics: EYONA nt'inexabiso Kobu bomi sibudlayo, Asikudla nezambatho, Asimpilo nakonwaba.
Komnceda ni na umntu, Ukuzuza lonk'ilizwe? Uze umphetumlo wona, Ulahlelwe emlilweni.
Eyona nt'inexabiso, Yimisebenzi yokholo, Kukuthwala umnqamlezo, Ngentobeko nengqobhoko.
Banoyolo abashiya, Inno zonke zehlabathi, Babalek'ugqatso lwabo, Bade baluphumelele.
Ma ndiphile nje ngelunga, Ndize ndi? ukuła kwalo, Ndakuhamba ngokulunga, Ndakoyisa kwa nje ngalo. - Amen.

title: KUKHO' iindlela ezimbini
lyrics: KUKHO' iindlela ezimbini, Ekuhanjwa ngazo apha, Enye iya eku feni, Enye iya ebomini.
Ieyo iya eku feni, Igudile, intle kambe, Iya hanjwa ngabaninzi, Besenziwa kuyithanda.
Bephikele Ieyo ndlela Ngobudenge nokumatha, Boda bazintywilisele Ebubini baphakade.
Enye incinane yona Inamatye, inameva Iyahanjwa ngabambalwa, Ngenxa yobunzima bayo.
Kanti iba mnandi noko, Kwabo bayiqhelileyo, Kuba iya ekhayeni, Elo balingxameleyo.
Iya ebungcwaliseni, Iya ekukhazimleni, Iya kumKhululi wabo, Iya eNkosini yabo.
Ma nizame le indlela, Nakuba inzima njalo, Kuba yona iphelela Kumihlali ne ziyolo. – Amen.

title: KUKH' induli eluhlaza
lyrics: KUKH' induli eluhlaza, Engabiyelwanga, Aph' u Yesu bamlimaza, Wafa engonanga.
Intlungu awazivayo, Asingezixeli, Umntu yena owonayo, Angenyamezeli.
Kwakungekho cebo limbi, Loku unlawful lityala, Kwakungekho ndlela yimbi, Yokusus' ixhala.
Lalivaliwe isango, Kungekho sitshixo, Kwakungekho nonebango, Engenabuthixo.
Zazingeze nengelosi, Zifele abaKhe, Kuba zazingesindise, Aho bafi baKhe.
Yayingu Ye onebango Hinobunzulu, Bokuvula amasango, Silingen' izulu.
Hayi! olo thando lw aKhe, Nge simthanda nathi, Sithemb' elo gazi laKhe, 'Ze simkhonze futhi. - Amen.

title: NAKU ndimi ndinkqonkqoza
lyrics: NAKU ndimi ndinkqonkqoza, Kolu cango lw akho moni, Ngelithambiley'ilizwi: Ndingene na? Ndingene na? Ndim'emnyango ndinkqonkqoza, Ndimi ndicenga ngomonde, Uthi ni mon'olusizi. Ndingene na? Ndingene na?
Ndawanyame zela mina Amanxeb'okube thelwa, Ngenxa yakho mgqithi ndimi: Ndingene na? Ndingene na? Ndim'emnyango,....
Ndev'iindungu zomnqamlezo, Ndalala nasengcwabeni, Ndizond'ukonwaba kwakho: Ndingene na? Ndingene na? Ndim'emnyango,....
Ndiza ndinoxolo lwakho, Ndiza nokonwaba kwakho, Wen' unamaxhal' ezono Ndingene na? Ndingene na? Ndim'emnyango,....
Ndingumhlobo ndibubomi, Ndilikhaka, ndililiwa, Ongazinqabisa kulo: Ndingene na? Ndingene na? Ndim'emnyango,....
Yemka ke imini yakho, Latshona ilanga lakho, Usesendlelen' yembubo: Ndingene na? Ndingene na? Ndim'emnyango,.... - Amen.

title: NDINIK' amehlo ndikhangele
lyrics: NDINIK' amehlo ndikhangele, Phezulu ebulwini, Ndibone khona abangcwele, Bevuya eNkosi.
Okuya babasemhlabeni, Belila inyembezi, Babandezelwa zizilungo, Umlingi engaphezi.
Ndibona se bezoyisile, Ndabuza “Kungani na? ‘Kungaye,’ batsho, ‘obefile’ Owayefela thina.
Babona inyathelo laKhe, Libheka ebomini, Bahamba emkhondweni waKhe, Baphumla ezulwini.
Makadunyiswe uMkhokeli, Ngalo mzekelo waKhe, Kungasweleki umlandeli Wasemkhondweni waKhe. - Amen.

title: NDIYAKHALA kuwe, Nkosil
lyrics: NDIYAKHALA kuwe, Nkosil Bawo Oyingcwele, ndive Kobu bugxwayiba, ndive Ekweneni kweli lizwe.
Ndiyigusha, ndalableka Ma ndifunwe, ndibuyiswe, Ndiyoyika kula mawa, Mandilandwe, ndigoduswe.
Ndaphambuka emendweni, Ndalushiy' ufe fe lwakho, Kwezi ntandabuzo zimbi Se ndeye le, ndiyatshona.
Enkungwini, ekufeni, Phuma, Langa lolungiso! Ma ndingena endleleni Ndilubone usindiso.
Ndipheleke, muKhululi! Ma ndiphathelele kuWe Koba mmandi ndakuhamba Nawe, ndize ndingadinwa
Ngoko ndinga ndingahamba Nawe, Nkosi enofefe, Ndiwanyuke amaqhina Neentsunguzi ezimnyama. - Amen.

title: NDIZA ndingento yalutho
lyrics: NDIZA ndingento yalutho, Ndicengwa ligazi laKho, Elaphalazwa ngenxa yam: Se ndisiqa, se ndisiqa,
Ndiza ndingento yalutho Ndize kuhlanjwa nguLowo, Onamandla okuhlamba: Se ndisiqa, se ndisiqa
Ndiza ndingento yalutho Ndingoyimfama zizono, Ndize kuzivuma kuWe: Se n'disiza, se n'disiza.
Ndiza ndingento yalutho Ndizele yintandabuzo, Noko ndinoko koyika: Se n'disiza, se n'disiza.
Ndiza ndingento yalutho, Ndize kucela uxolo. Ndize kufun'inkululo: Se n'disiza, se n'disiza
Ndiza ndingento yalutho, Se nditsalwa lolo thando, Endandingalwazi mina: Se n'disiza, se n'disiza. - Amen.

title: NDINGUMONI phambi kwakho
lyrics: NDINGUMONI phambi kwakho, Ndinetyala, Thixo wam! Ndalidela izwi Lakho Futhi entiz'yweni yam. Ndala imithetho yakho, Ngabo ubugeza bam.
Kodwa ngoku ndiza Kuwe Bona iinyembezi zam, Ndiza ndibiziwe Nguwe, Yiva ukulila kwam. Bawo, ndingxamele Kuwe, Yiba ngu-Mncedi wam.
Ndizixela phambi Kwakho Zonk'inkohlakalo zam, Ndiwe ezinyaweni Zakho Ekuthandazeni kwam. Ndilifun'itaru Lakho, Taru! Taru! Nkosi yam. - Amen.

title: LO mmiselo wobungcwele
lyrics: LO mmiselo wobungcwele Wenziwa ngu Yehova, Esi senzo sococeko Sasekwa ngu-Somandla, Emyezweni, Kusekh'ookhokho bethu.
Walthetha neli lizwi: 'Ma nichume, ze nande, Nize nizalise lonke Elimiweyo izwe' Emyezweni, Kusekh'ookhokho bethu.
Senza lo mmiselo ngoku Nakwezi ntsapho ze thu. Umthinjana nomlisela, Omiyo phambi kwethu Kule ndawo Kwisibingelo sethu
Ma badityaniswe Nguwe Khokho wookhokho be thu, Ma basikelelwe Nguwe, Kuyo le ntalo yethu, Ubakhaphe Kuzo iindlela zabo. - Amen.

title: THIXO! Ova izikhungo
lyrics: THIXO! Ova izikhungo, Obaxhas' abantu ba Kho, Othe Wena kule ntlango Wakhokel' oobawo bethu.
Nanga amadinga ethu, Siw abeka phambi kwakho Nazi ne zikhungo zethu, Siphe impendulo ya Kho.
Thixo! w ab' oobawo bethu, Yiba ngow asapho lwabo, Yiba nguy' u Bawo wethu, Usiphathe kwa nje ngabo.
Sohleka emhlabeni Sihambise endleleni, Usidlise, usiseze, Usigcine, usambe se.
Tweza amaphiko aKho, Ulufihl' usapho lwaKho, Side size kuWe, Baw o, Sihlangulwe kongendaw o. - Amen.

title: VUTHELANI ixilongo
lyrics: VUTHELANI ixilongo, Nina bantu baKhe! Ixilongo le zwi laKhe, Ma lihlokonyiswe.
Leyo nqwelo yezwi laKho, Ma yihambe yona. Kulo lonk' ilizwe Yesu, Ma yifike khona.
Vuthelani ixilongo, Nina bantu baKhe! Ma liviwe izwi lalo, Ngabo bangaboni.
Vuthelani ixilongo, Nina bantu baKhe, Lihanjiswe izwi laKhe, Elizweni lonke.
Ezo zizwe e zikude, Mazilazi lona, Zikhangele ku Msindisi, Zimamkele Yena - Amen.

title: KUKHO eka Thix' incwadi
lyrics: KUKHO eka Thix' incwadi, Yamagama abangcwele, Yabo bakholwayo ku Ye: Likhonan'igama Lakho?
Amaphepha ayo mahle, Soloko ecocekile, Ohlala ngonaphakade: Likhonan'igama Lakho?
Noxa apha alaziwa, Noxa aph' alidumanga, Phezulu phay' ezulwini Likhonan'igama Lakho.
Kwe zisemhlaben' incwadi, Lingabakh'igama lakho, Kodwa kweyobom' incwadi: Likhonan'igama lakho.
Ezalapha emhlabeni, Ziya guga, zilahleke, Eka Thixo ayigugi: Likhonan'igama lakho?
Liya baleka ixesha, Limka namathuba akho, Wuphendule ngok'umbuzo: Likhonan'igama lakho? - Amen.

title: NKOSI, ndive ngezibele
lyrics: NKOSI, ndive ngezibele, Ezesisa ezobom, Ozigalelayo wena, Mazifike zize kum Zize kum.
Ndingadlulwa Nkosi, Bawo! Ndingashiywa, Nkosi yam! Ndinezono entliziyweni, Kodwa noko yiza kum. Yiza kum.
Ndingadlulwa Msindisi! Ndingalahlwa Nkosi yam! Uyabiza ndiyanqwena, 'Zundibize ndize nam, Ndize nam.
Ndingadlulwa Moy'ongcwele! Ndingashiwa, Nkosi yam! Mandibone mina mfama, Them'ilizwi phezu kwam. Phezu kwam.
Olothando lwakho, Thixo, Elogazi, Nkosi yam! Izibele Zakho zonke, Mazihlale apha kum. Apha kum. - Amen.

title: NDIZALISE O Mkululi
lyrics: NDIZALISE O Mkhululi, NgoMoya oyiNgcwele, Ungumhlobo wethu, Mfeli, Yiza ngena uhlale.
Ungandizalisa wena- Akungexelelwe ndim, Ufuneka kakhulu kum, Ngo thando ndizalise.
Ndizele bubuthathaka, Ndiguqa enyaweni, Wena unawo amandla, Ndisize, ndiyatshona.
Thuthuzela, undihlambe, Ndihlambe intiziyo, Mthuthuzeli, ndisimdise, Wen'undizalisayo. - Amen.

title: NDIYAKUFUNA kum
lyrics: NDIYAKUFUNA kum, Wena Nkosi, Afikho ilizwi Iinjengelako.
Ndiyakufuna kum, Nceda hlala nam, Andisokuhluthwa Xa ndina We.
Ndiyakufuna kum, Yiza ndisize, Yiza kamsinyane Undincede.
Ndiyakufuna kum, Yiz'uhindise, Ngamadinga Akho Ndibabale.
Ndiyakufuna kum, Uyingcwele, Mandibe ngoWakho, Ndisindise. - Amen.

title: NOKO kunje apha
lyrics: Noko kunje apha Ukuba mmandi, Ndihulo undwendwe Kwa nomphambukeli.
Kwelam lon' ikhaya Asikho sono, Inzingo nentsizi Azaziwa konke.
Yesu ndikhuhule, Undihlambulule, Ndikhokele, Moya, Kulendlela yami.
Apha ndilundwendwe Kwa nowasemzini, Kodwa lon' ikhaya Lam lise-Zulwini - Amen.

title: NDINJE. Nkosi, ndiza ndinje
lyrics: NDINJE, Nkosi, ndiza ndinje, Nali lodwa izwi lam, Lokuba wandifela nam, Mvana kaThixo ndiyeza.
Ndinje, Nkosi, ndiza ndinje, Ndinge lisul' ityala lam, Ndohlaniwa ngelogazi nam, Mvana kaThixo ndiyeza.
Ndinje, Nkosi, ndiza ndinje, Ndinoval' en'diziyweni, Luyaphehla umbilini, Mvana kaThixo ndiyeza.
Ndinje, Nkosi, Ndiza ndinje, Ndibomvu ndinobumfama, Phofu konke usinika, Mvana kaThixo ndiyeza.
Ndinje, Nkosi, ndiza ndinje, Yihlambe intliziyo yam. Ndicokise, ndihlambise, Mvana kaThixo, ndiyeza.
Ndinje, Nkosi, ndiza ndinje, Ndibanga uthando lwakho, Ndiyaziphosa, ndingowakho, Mvana kaThixo, ndiyeza. - Amen.

title: SIBONG' uThixo
lyrics: SIBONG' uThixo, NgoNyana waKhe, NgoYesu owasifelayo thina.
Sibong'uThixo NgoMoya wakhe, Owasibonisa ilifa Lakho.
Uzuko lonke Kuyo iMvana Eyathwala izono entabeni.
Uzuko lonke, Nodumo lonke, Kulowo owasihlawulelayo.
Sivuselele Ngothando lwakho, Imiphefumlo mayihlaziyeke. - Amen.

title: HLALA nami kuyeza ukuhlwa
lyrics: HLALA nami kuyeza ukuhlwa, Sekuyahlwa, uzuhlale nami, Apho abanye sebesoyiswa, Wena ongoyiswayo, hlala nam.
Kuyakhawuleza okukufa kwam, Ubuhle obomhlaba buphina? Izinto zonke zitshabalala, Wen'ongaguqukiyo, hlala nam
Ndiyakucela uhlale nam, Ungeko, zondoyis' izilingo, Ungezi, Nkosi, njengodlulayo, Kodwa, Nkosi yam, nced'uhlale nam.
Kufunek'usolok'uhleli nam, Umlingi uyoyiswa lufefe, Ngubani ongaz'abe njengawe? Ngamazolo onke solok'unam.
Andoyiki xa ndihleli nawe, Inyembezi azinabukrakra, Kufa nengcwaba ningenzani kum? Ndinoloyiso xa uhleli nam. - Amen.

title: LANGA lomphefumlo wam
lyrics: LANGA lomphefumlo wam, Xa ukhoyo tu 'busuku Makungezi ubumnyama Buze buku fihle kuthi.
Naxa ndisekulaleni, Inkophe zam zilele yo, Ndiphumle kamnandi kuwe, Ngovuy' olukhulu kuwe.
Kusasa naxa kuhlwayo, Hlala nam ndiphile Nkosi Ubusuku busondele Hlala nam ndingafi Nkosi.
Kusasa ndisikelele Ndingekahamb'indlela yam, Ukuze ngothando lwakho Ndiyokuba sezulwini. - Amen.

title: XA uxolo lunje ngomlamb'omkhulu
lyrics: XA uxolo lunje ngomlamb'omkhulu, Xa ndinosiz'olukhulu Use undifundisile ukuthi, Kuhle ke, kuhle ke Moya wam.
Xa uSatana endikhathazayo, Ndiya kunqaba kaloku Ngokuthi uYesu undincedile, Waphalaz'igazi lakhe ngam.
Ingcamang'entle yile yo yokuba Zonge iziphosiso zam Uzibethelele emnqamlezweni Yibonge iNkosi moya wam.
Nkosi phangisisa usuku lwakho, Amafu aza kusongwa, Yehl'iNkosi ixilongo lakhala, Njalo ke kuhle moya wami - Amen.

title: MASIGCOBE namhla
lyrics: MASIGCOBE namhla, Kristu, sikubonge, Osikhululeyo Ekukhedameni, Wasithul' umthwalo We-Yiputh' onzima, Wasigabulela Olu-Bomv' ulwandle.
Owalal' ukufa Waba ntsuku ntathu, Uphumele thina, Langa laphakade, Yonk' inkohlakalo Yethu, njengengqele, Seyinyibilika 'Kubalela kwakho.
Onke amaxesha Onganyelwe leli, Sinom-Thendeleko Osivuyisayo. Thina bendlu yakho, I-Jerusaleme, Wenze simemeze Ngokuvuka kwakho.
Siyakudumisa, Sithi, Aliluya, Nkosi yaphakade, Eyoyis'ukufa, Kwa nakuwe, Bawo, Sithi, Aliluya, Aliluya kuwe, Moya Oyingcwele. - Amen.

title: SIBHAPATIZE Ngamandla akho
lyrics: SIBHAPATIZE Ngamandla Akho, Ngo thando sivuse! Yesu ngokwakho.
Asifanele, Ol sinentsila, Nkosi sihlambise kokubi konke.
Hobe lezulu, Yihla phezulul Sikucenga, ngentsikelelo Zakho.
Phulaphul' izwi lasezulwini- Uyathandeka kum, Ndigcobile ke. - Amen.

title: OWAKHO umbuso
lyrics: OWAKHO umbuso Mawufike, Nkosi, Eme namabhotwe Ekomkhulu lakho.
Mawubeth' utyumze Ngentonga yentsimbi Thixo ongu-Kristu, Incwangu yesono.
Uphin' umzi wakho, Umzi onoxolo ? Nguwuphina umhla Ekophel' intiyo ?
Ophela ninina Onke lamadabi ? Uralo nomngweno Zhaleke Wena ?
Vuka Wena, Nkosi, Uze ngomelelo , Safa kukangela, Slindele Wena.
Nawe uyagxekwa Apha elizweni Ubub'obukhoyo Babulal uthando.
Apha kwa-hedeni Kulel'ubumnyama, Vela, Kwezi, vela, Vela, ungatshoni. - Amen.

title: BAWO, osebenzayo
lyrics: BAWO, osebenzayo, Mzhasi wento zonke, Nguwe osiphileyo Amandl'ethu onke, Sincede, sisebenze Ngokukhutheleyo, Sisebenzele Wena, Ngezizandla zethu
Bulumko baphakade, Lizwi lika-Bawo, Ingqondo zihuzizi, Zikhanyise Wena: Sifund'imfundo yonke Esisipho Sakho Sikwazi Nawe, Kristu, Nowakuthumayo.
Moya wofefe lonke, Z'usive namhla nje, Sifle thina sonke, Xa ungekho Wena: Siphefumlele futhi Ngemvo ezingcwele, Nenene nolulamo Kunye nothandano
Bawo, Bulumko, Moya, Sihuleke kuhle, Ngemfundo nomsebenzi, Nokulunga konke, Uz'umzi lo wakuthi Ube mhl'emhlabeni, Sihungiselw'owakho Phezul'e-Zulwini. - Amen.

title: KONKE Yesu ndinikela
lyrics: KONKE Yesu ndinikela, Ndinikela ngesisa, Ndithembela njalo kuwe, Ndiphile nawe apha.
Ndiyanikela, Ndiyanikela, Konke kuye uMsindisi, ndiyanikela.
Konke Yesu ndinikela, Ndiguq' ezinyaweni, Nzuzo yomhlaba ndadela, Thatha Yesu, Ndithathe.
Ndiyanikela, Ndiyanikela, Konke kuye uMsindisi, ndiyanikela.
Konke Yesu ndinikela Ndenze ngcwele, Msindisi, Ndiphe owakho uMoya, Wen'ungowam ngenene,
Ndiyanikela, Ndiyanikela, Konke kuye uMsindisi, ndiyanikela.
Konke Yesu ndinikela, Ndiv'umlilo ongcwele, Nal'uvuyo losindiso, Lube kuye uzuko.
Ndiyanikela, Ndiyanikela, Konke kuye uMsindisi, ndiyanikela. - Amen.

title: AKWABA ndinemilomo
lyrics: AKWABA ndinemilomo Engaba lwaka, Ndidumise Wena, Thixo, Ngal' ufe fe Lwakho.
Likhup'uloyiko, Yesu, Eli-Gama Lakho, Lisusa zonke intlungu Kwabo bagulayo.
Waku thetha ngezwi Lakho Siyaphila thina, Abo bagqobhokileyo Liyabhaptizesha
Yivani, nina zithulu, Zidenge nemfama, Ziqhwala nani, gcobani, Uyez' uMsindisi.
Nkosi, Wena Thixo wam, Mawundomeleze Ndivise elihlabathi Ngeli gama Lakho. - Amen.

title: ILANGA liya tshona
lyrics: ILANGA liya tshona, Izulu liyaphumza, Linda uz' uthandaze, Ubusuku bukhanyis' izibane
Ngwele, ngwele, ngwele kuYehova, Izulu kwanombaba ziyambonga uBawo, uSomandla.
Nkosi yokuphila kwam, Izulu likhaya lam, Sibutha amadinga ombuso wokulunga, wasithenga.
Ngwele, ngwele, ngwele kuYehova, Izulu kwanombaba ziyambonga uBawo, uSomandla.
Ukuhlwa kusondele, Ngofefe yenz' inceba, Ubuso nobukhosi busithwe zinkwenkwezi, Uyingcwele.
Ngwele, ngwele, ngwele kuYehova, Izulu kwanombaba ziyambonga uBawo, uSomandla.
Xa singasaboniyo Ubusuku nemini Nkosi yaz' ingelosi, Makufike ukusa buka Yesu.
Ngwele, ngwele, ngwele kuYehova, Izulu kwanombaba ziyambonga uBawo, uSomandla. - Amen.

title: NDIYAKUTHANDA Nkos' Wena, Yesu wam
lyrics: NDIYAKUTHANDA Nkos' Wena, Yesu wam, Ngenxa yako ndiya zidel' izono, Unguye uMsindisi, Mfeli wam, Ubabeke ndakuthanda, kunamhla.
Ndiya kuthanda, kuba wandithanda, Wahlawulela phaya emnqamlezweni, Ndiyakuthanda kuba wandifela, Ubabeke ndakuthanda, kunamhla.
Ekuphileni kwa nasekufeni Ndizakudumisa uMsindisi wam, Ndothi elukhukwenilwam lokufa, Ubabeke ndakuthanda, kunamhla.
Kwizindlu zobukhosi ngokugcoba Ezulwini ndiya kukudumisa, Ndisholoze ndithwele isisaba, Ubabeke ndakuthanda, kunamhla. - Amen.

title: KWELOLIZWE lokukhanya
lyrics: KWELOLIZWE lokukhanya, Kukho umzi omhle, Awunakuz' uguge, Akukho busuku.
U-Thixo woqisula Inyembey' emehlwenzi, Nay'iminyaka khona Ayisoq'iphele
Ngamasang' eperile, Apho kumzi omhle, Istrato zigolide, Akukho busuku.
U-Thixo woqisula Inyembey' emehlwenzi, Nay'iminyaka khona Ayisoq'iphele
Masango akavalwa, Apho kumzi omhle, Kukho nomlambo wobom, Akukho busuku.
U-Thixo woqisula Inyembey' emehlwenzi, Nay'iminyaka khona Ayisoq'iphele
Langa alifineki, Apho kumzi omhle, Yi-Mvana ekukhanya Akukho busuku.
U-Thixo woqisula Inyembey' emehlwenzi, Nay'iminyaka khona Ayisoq'iphele - Amen.

title: MAQHAJI akomkhulu
lyrics: MAQHAJI akomkhulu, Zithatha zezwe lonke, Zdwangube ze-Nkosi, Zinduna zo-Sirayelí
Kwakumnyam'emhlabeni, Neza nesikhanyiso, Kwesaba zonk'izono, Kwavela inyaniso.
Neza ningenakrele, Ningenabughetseba, Nathimbela u-Kristu Ngomnqamlezo wehlazo.
Kwakulawula isono, U-Satan' esamele, Namhl'u-Thix' uyakhonzwa Kulawul' inkululeko.
Udumo lweli-Gama Likw o wonk'umhlaba, Kuzo zonke indawo U-Thixo uyaziwa.
Makudunyisw'u-Thixo Ozimilo zithathu, Osikhuph'emnyameni, Seza ekukhanyeni. - Amen.

title: YIVA, Mdali, Sozinceba
lyrics: YIVA, Mdali, Sozinceba, Siphulaphule ngofefe, Bona inyembe zi zethu Ngelixesha lokuzila.
Indiziyo, nobulwelwe Bethu buyaziw a nguwe: Sikufuna ngenguquko, Sixelele ngobubele.
Izono zethu zininzi, Siyazililela ngazo, Nge-Gama Lakho philisa Imiphefumlo efayo.
Siph' amandla, 'zengozilo Soyise yonk' iminqweno, 'Ze isind' imiphefumlo Ekudyojweni sisono.
Thixo Mtaniti Ongcwele, Wena siyakuthandaza, Sikelel' inzilo yethu, Ibe neziqham' ezihle. - Amen.

title: BAWO, odale konke ngothando
lyrics: BAWO, odale konke ngothando, Khangel' olusana Olungen' endeleni yobomi, Ngokubizwa Nguwe Bek' owakh' umfanekiso Phezu komphemfulo walo Sive, Bawo!
Nyana ka-Thix' owasifelayo, Simzisile Kuwe, Malusi olungileyo, mthabathe Ahlal' engo Wakho, Mkhusele emizameni, Umbonis' indlel' obomi, Thixo Nyana!
Moya owafukamel' amaza, Ngena kulomntwana, Umdlis' ubom, uhlamb' umoya wakhe Ngamanzi angcwele, Yena abe ngumzi wakho Umntwana ongoka-Thixo Moy'Ongcwele!
Kwenzekile okuyaleleyo, Thixo M-Trinit, Langa labalapha naphezulu Mkhanyselı umntwana, Hukhohwen', ethembeni Huthandweni, novuyo, M-Trinit! - Amen.

title: ISIQALO sobulumko
lyrics: ISIQALO sobulumko Kukoyika Wena, Bawo: Sibabale ngobulumko Bokoyika Wena, Bawo.
Ukoyika Wena, Bawo, Kunceda ngendlela zonke: Kusigcina ekoneni, Kusiqhubel' ebomini.
Ukoyika Wena, Bawo, Kusikhusel' ebubini, Kusenza sithiye konke Okulisikizi Kuwe.
Ukoyika Wena, Bawo, Kusithiyisa nesono, Kusenza nyulu ngomzimba, Kuhlambulul' umphemfulo
Kuyalicekis' ikratshi Akubonani nolunya, Akubonani nomona, Akwazani nobuvila.
Kusinika intobeko, Kusinika ululamo, Kusinik' ukuzoyisa Kusinika intembeko.
Masamkel' uMoya Wakho Sifunde ukukoyika, Yise, Nyana, Moy' Ongcwele, Thixo, M-Tinidi Ongcwele. - Amen.

title: BUYA, mphefumlo wam
lyrics: BUYA, mphefumlo wam, Buyela e Nkosini, Buya namhla e zonweni Ungasingi ekufeni, Buya, mphefumlo wam.
Lila, mphefumlo wam, Izono zililele, Zonk' izono zihhlazo, Wena noko usenazo, Lila mphefumlo wam.
Khunga, mphefumlo wam, Ukhunge kuMkhululi, Riza futhi e Nkosini, Yova yona ezulwini, Khunga mphefumlo wam.
Themba mphefumlo wam Uthembel' e Nkosini, Yeza yona emhlabeni, Uze uye ezulwini: Themba, mphefumlo wam.
Vuya mphefumlo wam, Vuyela uMsindisi, Weza yena wakufela, Seleya kukuxolela: Buya, mphefumlo wam. - Amen.

title: UYINDLELA yenyaniso
lyrics: UYINDLELA yenyaniso, Nyana Lo ka Thixo wam, Ndimi ngawe onk'amaxa, Wena unobomi bam.
Uthi ngobubele Bakho, 'Sondelani nonke Kum, Ndonivis' olwam uxolo, Ndonivis' ufe fe lwam.
'Khawulezani, nab'ubomi Eniyakubudla ngam, Nas' iSonka, esezulu, Sondelani, nitye nam
'Ndisi-Sonka sokuphila, Ndingamanzi abubom, Nngasela nitye nonke, Nze e-zulwini kum.'
Nkosi, ndomeleze mina, Ndize ndidi' ubomi nam, Ndibe nokukudumisa Ngayo indiziyo yam. - Amen.

title: NDIKHOKELE, O Mkhululi
lyrics: NDIKHOKELE, O Mkhululi, Ndicand' ubugxwayiba, Ndipheleliwe, mandibanjwe Ngeso sakho sithe-nkqi: Wena sonka Saphezulu, xhasa mna.
Tyhila ngok' umthombo lowo Umpompoz' awempilo, Ithi nentsika yomlilo Indikhaphe nanini: Msindisi, Mandla am nekhakha lam.
Ndikudini lwase-Jordan Yitsho ndingaxhalabi, Wena mvingci wesihogo, Ndise ngapho eKanan, Imbongo Ndokwenzel' amax' onke. - Amen.

title: INYE indlela kwaphela
lyrics: INYE indlela kwaphela, Yokuphuma ekoneni, Esa kwelozwe linyulu, Kuba ngu Thixo okhona.
Inyaniso nayo inye, Yeka Thixo kwakuphela, Ubom nabo bukwabunye, Bob' asithengele bona.
Okwamsithelay' uFilipu, Siyakwazi ngay' uKristu, Simtyhilelwe ngay' uYise, Zeyisakal' üntliziyo.
Ukholo lubambelele Kweka Yakob' imfundiso, Xa singabambelelanga, Siyakuphoswa lizulu.
Yesu, Ndilela, Nene, Bomi, Sikokhelel' eZulwini, Size ke ekupheleni Sihlale siphambi Kwakho. - Amen.

title: INDUMISO yethu
lyrics: INDUMISO yethu Ife ziwe ngoku, Nanga namathunz' okuhlwa Esiwa phezulu
Kodwa, Lukanyiso Olungapheliyo, Uz'ungasishiyi sodwa, Uxel' elilanga
Phambi kwe Trone Yakho, Ubusuk' abukho, Izithunywa ezulwini Zihleli zicula.
Kanti noko, Nkosi Intliziyo yethu Ilungeleliswe Nguwe, Sohlomela nathi
Ungumthuthuzeli, Beyisele Kuwe Nabo balahlekiswayo Yintliziyo yabo
Akusexa lide, Sifik' isiphelo: Ingom' ewunywa zingelosi Ine nye neyethu. - Amen.

title: BHETLEHEM, wena umkhulu
