lyrics: BHETLEHEM, wena umkhulu Kwizixeko zomhlaba, Kuba kuwe kwazalelwa Umlawuli kaSirayeli
Yabengezel'inkwenkwezi Eyabikel'ilizwe Ukwenziw'abe yinyama Kuka Thix'uSomandla
Izilumko zakudala Zeza nentlak'emhlophe, Negolide nobulawu, Zivel'empumalanga.
Zibonisa okokuba Ngu-Thixo wokunqulwa, U-Kumkani woKumkani, Ongasoze abole.
Yes'owanqulwa zintlanga Ngomhla we-Epifani, Uzuko Kuwe, noYise NoMoya oyiNgcwele. - Amen.

title: XA ixilongo likhala
lyrics: XA ixilongo likhala nexesha selidlule, Ko fika usuku olumi njalo, Abasindiswayo behlanganiselwa kwelo zwe, Bebizwa phezulu ndakuba khona.
Xa sebe... bizwa phezulu, Xa sebe... bizwa phezulu, Xa sebe... bizwa phezulu, Bebizwa phezulu ndakuba khona.

Masiyisebenzele iNkosi lide litshone, Masazisane ngothando lweNkosi, Singafa, uyaphela umsebenzi wethu apha Bebizwa phezulu ndakuba khona.
Xa sebe... bizwa phezulu, Xa sebe... bizwa phezulu, Xa sebe... bizwa phezulu, Bebizwa phezulu ndakuba khona. - Amen.

title: SINYÉ isiseko sebandla, ngu Yesu
lyrics: SINYÉ isiseko sebandla, ngu Yesu, Uzidalele lona ngamanzi nelizwi. Yena wehl'ezulwini wazimanya nalo, Walithenga ngegazi, wafa ngenxa yalo.
Banyulwe emhlabeni, bahlangene kulo, Lithi, 'Inye iNkosi, ukholo, nozalo, 'Iinye igama kwane Sonka esingcwele.' Kukho ithemba linye elinobabalo.
Liyahlekwa liyacinez elwa kakhulu, Luyahlukan' utshaba apho kukh' u Yesu. Abangcwele ngokholo bathi, "Koba nini?" Kwaka msinyane kuza kuphel' ukukhala.
Phakathi kwenkathazo, intlungu, nenzima, Lilindele umvuzo woxol' olukhulu, Kothi ekupheleni kuvel' ukukhanya, Kophela konk' ukulwa ibandla loyise. - Amen.

title: SINESIPHO esikhulu
lyrics: SINESIPHO esikhulu, Esisiphiweyo thina, Sisiphiwe ngu-Yehova, Esosipho esinaso.
Sinqabile esosipho Kwabo basizuzileyo, Basithanda sona kanye, Phezu kwento abanazo.
Singamandla esosipho Kwabo basifumeneyo, Sibubomi esosipho Kwabo abasamkeleyo
Esosipho singu-Yesu, Esisiphiweyo thina, Usisipho esikhulu Kwabo abakholiweyo.
Simbulela u-Yehova Ngesosipho esikhulu, Simbulel' u-Thixo yedwa, Ngokusiph' u-Nyana Wakhe. - Amen.

title: SOBHEKA phina, Thixo
lyrics: SOBHEKA phina, Thixo, singabheki Kuwe? Soncedwa ngubanina, singancedwa Nguwe? Wadala thina bantu, wenza into zonke, Umise nenkululo, sisindiswe sonke.

Siphahle ngezibele koluhambo lwethu, Sincede endleleni ngokuswela kwethu Sixhase ekufeni, singahlehli Kuwe, Samkele ezulwini, ngosimnikwe nguwe.
Amen.

title: KUMNANDI ukuthandaza
lyrics: KUMNANDI ukuthandaza, kundibiz' elusizini, Kundibikela kuBawo, konke oku kuswela kwam, Ngamaxesha enkathazo ndizuza ukupholiswa, Andiwole ngamaphiko, ngomoya wokuthandaza.
Kumnandi ukuthandaza, kundithwalel' izicelo, Aze othembekileyo andisikelele yena, Uthi mandicinge ngaye, mandikholwe lizwi lakhe, Uyakundinceda yena, ndakulinda ndithandaze.

Amen

title: AKUHLANGA lungehlanga
lyrics: AKUHLANGA lungehlanga, Dade, nani bazalwana, Lo mntu usishivileyo, Nguye ogodukileyo.

Akuhlanga lungehlanga Noko ngathi kubuhlungu, Lo mmiselo wuqondeni, Lo mmiselo wuqheleni. - Amen.

title: LUSAPHO loKumkani
lyrics: LUSAPHO loKumkani, Vumani ngokuvuya, Vumelan'uMsindisi, Nuvume ngokuvuya
Vumani xa nihamba, Nuya ku-Thix' ekhaya, Lo ndlela yabadala, Ababehamba ngayo.
Bavuyel'uMsindisi, Nengabo sakuvuya, Lakufika elethu Ixesha lokuvuya.
Mhlanjana! vuyani ke, Nophumlela kuYesu, Apho likhon' ikhaya Ikomkhulu nomvuzo. - Amen.

title: MANINGENZ' isono
lyrics: MANINGENZ' isono Maningathethi Amazwi amabi, Ntsapho yeNkosi.
Ningabaka Yesu Onobubele, Nabantwana Bakhe Mababe ngcwele.
Kodwa kukh'umoya, Ongongendawo, Onizinga futhi, Ukuze none.
Ize ningawuva, Ze niwuchase, Nokuya kunzima Ukwenjenjalo.
Ke nithembisile Ebusaneni Ukulwa nomiyholi, Nendlela zakhe.
Nina ke nenziwe Abaka Kristu: Fundani ukulwa Nenkohlakalo.
Eyenu iNkosi Ilunge kanye, Ntabantwana bayo Mababe ngcwele. - Amen.

title: UNGUMDALI wento zonke
lyrics: UNGUMDALI wento zonke, Nezisezulwini Nawe, Nezisemhlabeni wonke, Zonke izinto zime Ngawe.
Zazidalwa ngezwi Lakho, Ngezwi linamandla onke Sithi ubukhulu Bakho Sibubone ngazo zonke.
Nkosi! singa singahamba Phantsi kobukhulu Bakho. Nkosi! singa singahamba Zonke iziyalo zakho. - Amen.

title: AMAXHWANE abingwayo
lyrics: AMAXHWANE abingwayo Ngama-Yuda akudala Akabanga nalusizo Kwizizwe ezingakwazanga.
Kodwa Wena Kristu, Xhwane Elabingelelw’ abonii, UliDini lenyaniso, Negazi elihlambayo.
IGazi elimpompozayo Ecaleni laKho, Yesu, Laphalazelwa iintlanga Ezingakwazanga, Yesu.
Luze ngokubingwa kwaKho Olusindiso lwezizwe, Nyana kaThixo wozuko, Ndlalifa yamaphakade.
Kuze, zisele eloGazi, Ube kukuphila kwazo, Kuze, zidle nalomZimba, Kube kukonwaba kwazo. - Amen.

title: NGELO xa lokushiywa
lyrics: NGELO xa lokushiywa, Ngabo abathandayo, Sokhala kuwe Nkosi, Nyana kaThixo sive!
Iakusishiy’ ithemba, Ugetsi lwethu lobo, Sokhala kuwe Nkosi, Nyana kaThixo sive!
Sakutoba iintloko, Ilizwi usizi, Sokhala kuwe Nkosi, Nyana kaThixo sive!
Satuva ukubuhlungu, Imfesane isika, Sokhala kuwe Nkosi, Nyana kaThixo sive!
Sakuvuk’ isazela Ngokuba sikonile, Sokhala kuwe Nkosi, Nyana kaThixo sive!
Duyile usizi, Wafila inyembezi, Sothemba Wena Nkosi Nyana kaThixo sive! - Amen.

title: MONWABISI oyiNgcwele
lyrics: MONWABISI oyiNgcwele, Mthombo wazo zonke, Hlis’ umbethe waKho Yiva ukukunga kwethu, Utyebis’ umhlaba wethu Ngobunyela kwaKho.
Sonwabis’ thina sonke, Usivise uxolo lonke Ngoku nguna kwaKho. Sikhokele enyanisweni, Usimise entandweni, Ngokutsiza kwaKho.
Sothi, salathiswe Nguwe, Side sifikelele Kuye UMsindisi wethu, Sibubon’ ubuso Bakhe, Glubong’ ufefe lwaKho Ekhayeni letu. - Amen.

title: UYES’ uyakulawula
lyrics: UYES’ uyakulawula Aph’ ilanga lihambayo, Both’ ubukumkani Bakhe Buzalise zonke indawo, Zid’ iinyanga zingatshwasi, Neminyaka ingapheli.
Intandazo ngentandazo Zohlokoma ngenxa Yakhe, Zonyukela iindumiso, Zibe sisitsaba sakhe, Kuqhunyiswe amadini Okuqhol’ igama lakhe.
Boluncom’ uthando Lwakhe, Ngazi’ iingoma ezimnandi, Zithi zonke’ iilwimi zabo Zitsholoze okumandi Kuvakal’ amazw’ eentsana, Ehlokoma kwangesandi.
Kuzalis’ intsikelelo, Aph’ uYes’ alawulayo Amakhonxwa akhululwe, Awe amakhamandela, Aphunyuzw’ odiniweyo, Aneliswe osweleyo.
Izidalwa ezikhoyo, Maziguqe phambi KwaKhe, Zibe zezi qhayisayo, Ngaw’ amandl’ ofefe lwaKhe Zidabane nabezulu, Ngokumnik’ udumo Lwakhe. - Amen.

title: YITHWESEN’ iMvana !missing page 169!
lyrics: YITHWESEN’ iMvana Ngazo izitsaba, Phulaphula! itshatshisele Ingoma yeZulu: Phakama uvume Ngowakufelayo, NguKumkani wakho wedwa, Wena mphefumlo wam.
Mthweseni uNyana WeNtomb’ uMariya, UThixo ezelwe ngumntu, Uzifumanele Ubukhosi Yena, Ahonjiswe ngabo, Lusana lwaseBhetelehem, Sebe likaIsaya.

title: NAMHLA sizalelw’ umntwana
lyrics: NAMHLA sizalelw’ umntwana, Indlalifa yamadinga. Nguye okaThix’ uNyana, Ofikele emhlabeni.
Sizalelwe uMsindisi, Uze kusiphakamisa, Uze kukhulul’ uluntu, Ngofefe walusindisa.
Amazisa amanyange, Ephefumlelwa ngumoya, Athi: Nguye ovumileyo Ukusindisa ilizwe.
UyiNkosi yamabandla, Nok’ eshiye ubukhosi, Ma simamkelele ngovuyo, Nangokholo lwentliziyo. - Amen.

title: MANDIHAMBE Nawe, Yesu
lyrics: MANDIHAMBE Nawe, Yesu, Kuzo zonke indlela zam, Izwi laKho mandilive Lonk’ ixesha, Nkosi yam.
Mandihambe Nawe, Yesu, Zulwandis’ uthando lwam, Ndonwabi’ imini yonke Xa ukhoyo, Nkosi yam.
Mandihambe Nawe, Yesu, Uzoyis’ intshaba zam, Unamandla, andinawo, Lawula, lawula, Nkosi yam.
Mandihale Nawe, Yesu, Kwakutk’ uku lwaKwam, Zundamkele ezulwini, Ndiyekuwe, Nkosi yam. - Amen.

title: UPHILILE uMsindisi
lyrics: UPHILILE uMsindisi, Uphilile Yena, Sivuyiswa thina boni, Uphilile yena.
Ebe file uMsindisi, Ebe file yena Wabulawa ngenxa yethu Wabulawa yena.
Unyukela ezulwini Unyukile yena Usithandazela thina Kuthandaza yena.
Uya lawula uMsindisi Ulawulela thina Sisindiswe ezonweni Sisindiswe thina. - Amen.

title: NKOSI Thixo Mtrinitti
lyrics: NKOSI Thixo Mtrinitti, Wena Mphathi omkhulu, Yiva thina sakuthi Sikucelele.
Thix’ ongu Sokukhanya, Khanyisel’ iintliziyo, Sihlal’ eluthandweni Ngofefe lwaKho.
Kwakuhlwa imini le, Izono zixolele, Noxolo luthumele Olwaphezulu.
Nkosi, singa singathi Sikhonze Wena njalo Apha, naseZulwini Ngonaphakade. - Amen.

title: Yizani Ma-Kristu
lyrics: Chorus: Yizani, simbulise, Yizani, simbulise, Yizani, simbulise u-Kristu I-Nkosi.
Yizani, ma-Kristu, Siye ngokuvuya, Yizani, masiye e-Bethelehem, Siye kumbona Ozalelwe thina, (Chorus)
* Ngezwi le-Ngelosi, Ukuya kumbona esemkhombeni, Masiye nathi, Siye ngokuvuya, (Chorus)
* Zikhokelwe kude, Zamsela izipho zelakowazo, Masiye nathi, Simsel' intliziyo, (Chorus)
Nguthixo ka Thixo, Engumntwana womntu, Ezelwe yi-Ntombi ayenzileyo Akenziwanga, Ungunaphakade, (Chorus)
Culani nivuye, Nani zi-Ngelosi, Nivume ingoma, sivume nathi, Simbonge apha, Nani ngaphezulu, (Chorus)
Al Yesu! Lusana! Siyakubulisa, Kungathi siyaya e-Bethelehem, Siye kubona Aph' uzelwe khona, (Chorus)
* Inkazimlo yakho, Wen' oyinkazimlo ka-Sokukhanya. Thixo wenene, Wasingathwa ngumntu, (Chorus)
* Uzuzisa thina, Usesibayeni sikubulisa, Usithandile, Mawungathandwa na? (Chorus) - Amen.

title: Ikhaya Loyolo
lyrics: Ikhaya loyolo Lingaphaya kweli, Izilinga zikho Khona, nenyembezi Kobe nal' ukholo, Ngentemb' eqinileyo Yonk' inzaliseko Iba sekuhleni.
Kukh' izw' e loxolo, Laziwa 'Zizthunywa, Ingom' ayipheli Kuwo lomasango, Lo Tron' ingqongiwe Zi-Ngcwele zakhona, Ziqhuba umbuso Wazo ku-Mtimiti.
Uyolo lukhulu, Lokubon' I-Mvana Eyasifelayo, Nalomanxeb' ayo, Snik' uzuko Olufaneleyo, Syakalis' into Esenzele zona.
Bhekani phezulu Ngcwele zika-Thixo, Nihambe indlela Awahamba ngayo, Lindan' umzuzwana Ningenakukrokra Wobehl' anamkele Kwelokhaya Lakhe. - Amen.

title: Sikelela Isithebe
lyrics: Sikelela isithebe, Esiphambi kwethu, Sondle imizimba yethu Kwanempilo yethu.
Esisonka sisityayo Siphiwe Nguwe, Nalamanzi aselwayo Siwanikwa Nguwe. - Amen.

title: Yivan' Ilizwi LesiBhalo
lyrics: Chorus: Ngenisani konke okweqishumi, Ndiodinge, thsho iNkosi, Ndiompha tintsikelelo, Kade kuswelek' indawo yokugcina.
Yivan' ilizwi lesiBhalo Lithi, 'Ngenisani konke okweshumi:' Zisan' Umbingelelo waphakade, Themban' ukusikelelwa. (Chorus)
Ninga ningaz' amandl' omoy' ongcwele? Ngenisani konke okweshumi, Ngenisani konke okweshumi, Thethani nenkosi onke amaxa, Ngoku isasikelela. (Chorus)
Nahlulwa yinina nenkosi yenu? Ngenisani konke okweshumi, Ngenisani ngokomyalelo Wakhe, Uyakunisikelela. (Chorus)
Nyusan' intliziyo nithi: YiNkosi xa nizisa konke okweshumi, Themban' amadinga, noba novuyo, Xa nimnike intliziyo. (Chorus)
Hlabelan' ingom' emandi kakhulu Ngexesha nizisa okweshumi. Sithi: Haleluya! Ngezw' elimnandi, Szuze intsikelelo. (Chorus) - Amen.

title: Nguthixo Owenze Zonke
lyrics: Nguthixo owenze zonke Izinto ezinde, Zonk' indidi zezinto Nezithi-manga.
Ngu-Menzi wentyatyambo, Namabala azo, Ayenzel' amaphiko Nentak' evumayo.
Isityebi nehlwempu Benziwe ngu-Thixo, Ophezulu nophantsi Namawonga abo.
Intaba eluhlaza, Umlamb' odlulayo, Ukuhlwa, kwa nokusa Okukhanyisayo.
Umoya nobusika, Ilanga nehlobo, Iziqham' emyezweni, Nguy' u-Menzi wazo.
Imithi ehlabathini, Nentli ehlabathini, Ingcongol' emlanjeni Siya zisiphula.
Wasinika amehlo Oba sizibone, Nomlomo wokuxela Ubukhulu bakhe. - Amen.

title: Yizani, Namkel' U-Mzimba We-Nkosi
lyrics: Yizani, namkel' u-Mzimba we-Nkosi Ne-Gazi enliphalezelweyo.
Lidin' elizalisekileyo, Somelezwe, siyabulela.
U-Krist' u-Nyana ka-Thixo wethu, Ngokufa kwakhe, wanokoyisa.
Ungumnike l' ofezekileyo, Ngokufa kwakhe, wanokoyisa.
Amadimi abebingelelwa, Ashumayela ukufa kwe-Nkosi.
Oyintlawulelo eyaneleyo Ngu-Kristu, oyi-Pasika yethu.
Wasinika amelho Oba sizibone, Nomlomo wokuxela Ubukhulu bakhe.
Nas' i-Sonka essiphiweyo Singu-Mzimba ongcwele ka-Kristu.
Ne-Wayin' emiselweyo yi-Nkosi, Ili-Gazi layo elingcwele.
I-Nkos' ikho edinini lethu, Kwa njengokwesithembiso sayo. - Amen.

title: Akukho Koyika Apho
lyrics: Akukho koyika apho Ku-Baw' e-Zulwini: Akukh' naliny' ixhala Aph' ahleli khona.
Akukho sono khon' apho Komkhulu, kwa-Thixo, Nako ukungcol' akukho Kwelo le-Ngelosi.
Akukho neny' inxwaleko Phezulu, ekhaya: Akukho bunzima bani Kwelo linophumlo.
Ukuswela nentuthumbo, Intsizi nenzingo, Ingxabano nemisindo- Kwelo linophumlo.
Azi soyiva ninina Londa' ibuyolo? Azi sowubona nini Lowomzi ka-Bawo? - Amen.

title: Thixo, Ongu-Bawo Wethu
lyrics: Thixo, ongu-Bawo wethu, Naku sihlangene, Thina silusapho lwakho, Vela usamkele.
Kuzo zonk' imbandezelo, Kwa nentsizi zethu, Sizibika kuwe, Bawo, Ngamaxesha onke.
Sikhulise, usondlele Kulo i-Zwi lakho, Kuba Wena wasithanda Ngobubele bakho.
Yiba nathi kwakaloku Ebuncinaneni, Usiweze kwingxingongo Apha emhlabeni.
Sikhusele sinqabise Siphe kwa nokholo Side siye e-Zulwini Ngobabalo lwakho. - Amen.

title: Khumbulan' U-Thixo Wenu
lyrics: Khumbulan' u-Thixo wenu, Lowo unguMdali wenu, Owadal' abantu bonke. Yalekani, nimhlonele, Wonibuka ngobubele, Ma kakhonzwe nini nonke.
Khumbulan' u-Thixo wenu, Lowo ungumgcini wenu, Ungumgcini wento zonke, Nakumenz' amandla enu, Abe sisixhobo senu, Ma kathenjwe nini nonke.
Khumbulan' u-Thixo wenu, Lowo unguYihlo wenu, Onofefe kuni nonke Thandazani nisondele, Wova anisikelele, Ma kathandwe nini nonke. - Amen.

title: Thixo Ndikhangele Kuwe
lyrics: Thixo Ndikhangele Kuwe, Nkosi Ndisindise, Izwi lokubiza kwami Ma lifike Kuwe.
Nguwe oyiNkosi yami Ndilinda yona, Ndithi, ngentliziyo yami, Ndoza ndikubone.
Ndenje njalo ukucinga, Ezi ntsuku zonke, Ndikhumbule ukusinga Apho umi khona.
Liphi ikomkhulu Lakho Apho wakhe khona? Ma undivumele, Nkosi, Ndiye kukubona. - Amen.

title: Bawo Wethu, O SeZulwini
lyrics: Bawo wethu, o seZulwini, Maliphathwe ngobungcwele i Gama lakho. Ubukumkani bako mabufike. Intando yakho mayenziwe emhlabeni, Njengokuba isenziwa eZulwini.
Siphe namhlanje isonka, sethu semihla ngemihla. Usixolele izono zethu, Njengokuba nathi sibaxolela, abo basonayo thina.
Ungasingenisi ekuhendweni, Usisindise enkohlakalweni: Ngokuba ubukumkani bobaKho, Namandla, inga waKho' Nobungcwalisa ibobakho Kude kube ngunaphakade. - Amen.

title: Isiseko Se-Kerike
lyrics: Isiseko se-Kerike Singu-Kristu I-Nkosi, Isisdalwa sakhe Ngamanzi ne-Gazi, Wayezenzela ibe Ngu-Mtshakazi wakhe, Ohla! esidl' ubomi, Ngokokufa kwakhe.
Ikuzo zonk' indawo Le-Kerike inye, Intanga zonke kuyo Zabunjwa zabanye, Ngalo u-Khol' olunye, Ngo-Bhaptizo olunye, Nange-Nkosi enye.
Noko Ikrazukile Ngemfundis' ezimbi, Noko ibandezelwe Zintshaba zaphandle, Basaland' a-Bangcwele Ukufika kwakhe U-Myeni we-Kerike, Abathuthuzele.
Ebunzimeni bonke Nasemgciphekweni, Isalind' ukufezwa Koxolo noyolo, Ayinakudiniswa, Ayinakoyiswa, Ne-Kerike' isoyisa Yoba nokuphumla.
Kanti ke imanyene No-Thix' u-Mtriniti, Nobudlelan' obuhle Nabasebemkile: Hayi ubuyolo babo! Kristu, siph' uxolo, Sihlale kuwe nabo Ngamaxesha onke. - Amen.

title: Khaya Lam, Jerusaleme
lyrics: Khaya lam, Jerusaleme, Ndoba kuwe nini? Ezintsizi zam ziphele, Ndiv' uyolo nini?
Sezithweswe khon' I-Ngcwele, Ziyambon' u-Thixo: Ziseyisa, zisagcoba, Hayi inyweba yazo!
Thina ke, singabagxothwa, Sisambambazela, Siyalila, siyancwina, Senza isijwili.
Okumnandi kubukrakra, Tu nto ibuyolo: Kuthi-banga, sisajonga, Kusal' intsizi nje.
Apho ngenxa yokonwaba, Ngenxa yemihlali, Iminyaka eliwaka Ngathi yimin' inye.
Hayi ubuhle bemiyezo! Mihle kanye bethu, Hayi imithi neziqhamo! Zingumangaliso.
Khona apho kuluhlaza Ngawo onk' amaxa: Zikho nentyatyamb' ezintle, Ziqholis' umoya.
Khaya lam, Jerusaleme, Ndanga ndingakhona: Zanga zingaphel' intsizi, Ndiv' uyolo Lwakho! - Amen.

title: Thetha Nomphefumlo Wam
lyrics: Chorus: Thetha nam usebenza uthando lwakho kum, Yithi, 'Ungumeyisi, ukhulule', Thetha yonk' imihla, Nkosi, ngelithambileyo, Ndisebezele uthi akundishiyile.
Thetha nomphefumlo wam ngelithambileyo, Ngolo thando yithi kum, 'Akushiyw' e wedwa', Vula lentliziyo yam, Ive wena ngoku, Ndizale yindumiso, Mandigcobe ngawe. (Chorus)
Nab' abantwana bakho, bakhokele wena, Bazalise ngovuyo, nangokuthandaza, Baphelelise kuwe, bonk' ubomi babo. Khawuleza ufike, size sikubone. (Chorus)
Wena wazithulayo kwabo bakudala, Ndazis' imfanelo yam, emthethweni wakho, Ndize ndikuzukise, ndiboniswa nguwe. Ndiyavuya Nkosi yam, ndinembeko kuwe. - Amen.

title: Will your anchor hold in the storms of life
lyrics: Will your anchor hold in the storms of life, When the clouds unfold their wings of strife? When the strong tides lift and cables strain, Will your anchor shift or firm remain?
We have an anchor that keeps the soul Steadfast and shore while the billows roll, Fastened to the rock which cannot move, Grounded firm and deep in the Saviour's love.
It is safely moored, 'twill the storm withstand, For 'tis well secured by the Saviour's hand, And the cables passed from his heart to mine, Can defy the blast, through his strength divine. - Amen.

title: THE Church's one foundation
lyrics: THE Church's one foundation Is Jesus Christ her Lord, She is his new creation By water and the Word: From heav'n He came and sought her To be his holy bride, with his own blood He bought her, And for her life He died.

Now she on earth hath union With God the Three in One, And mystic sweet communion With those whose rest is won: O, happy ones and Holy! Lord, give us grace that we, Like them, the meek and the lowly, On high may dwell with Thee!

Elect from every nation, Yet one o'er all the earth, Her charter of salvation - One Lord, one faith, one birth: One Holy Name she blesses, Partakes one Holy food, And to one hope she presses, With ev'ry grace endued. - Amen.

title: We thank thee God of Israel
lyrics: We thank Thee God of Israel For this day Thou has given us. For the joy, peace and prosperity, Thou has given us, O, praise Thy Name.
You're the light upon our way And we trust in Thee, O Lord. Thou has given us strength and courage, O Lord Jesus, our eternal friend.
O Lord Jesus, our eternal friend. - Amen.

title: SIDL' Isonka ka se-Zulu
lyrics: SIDL' isonka se-Zulu Mzimba wakh' oyinyama Dlis' umphefumlo wethu Ngesonka senyaniso Yonk' imihla siphiwa Ngulow' asifelayo
Gazi lase Zulwini Ndeb' esikelelweyo Yesu lomanxeba akho, Ajong' emnqamlezweni Yesu masihlaliswe Similiselwe Nawe - Amen.

title: MVANA kaThixo
lyrics: MVANA kaThixo, Mvana kaThixo, Esusa izono zelizwe Izono ze lizwe Izono ze lizwe Senzele senzele inceba - Amen.

title: AMEN, Amen, Amen
lyrics: AMEN, Amen, Amen, Uzuko ku-Yise Naku-Nyana No-Moy' oYingcwele, Kwakunjalo ekuqalekeni Kuya kubanjalo Ngona phakade, Amen.
